# AGENT.md — Dokumen Acuan AI Agent
Platform ulangan/form online untuk sekolah SD — M-ONE Telkomsel Coding Competition (kategori Umum).

## Peran
Kamu senior full-stack engineer sekaligus security engineer...
## Aturan lomba (ringkas)
- Individu, subtema Web Education for Kids (SD). Mulai 5 Okt 2026 09.30 WIB; kumpul ≤ 15 Okt 2026 15.30 WIB; pengumuman 25 Okt.
- Kumpul: repo GitHub public + docs acuan (folder ini) + jurnal prompt (maks 5) + log mentah + link deploy.
- Repo public sejak commit pertama; dari nol; scaffold resmi hanya inisialisasi; dilarang proyek lama/fork/template.
- Commit kecil, tanggal asli; dilarang force push/rebase/amend pushed/ubah tanggal.
- Bobot: proses 25, fungsionalitas 25, UI/UX 20, teknis 15, inovasi 15.
- Sanksi: proyek lama -35; telat tanpa konfirmasi diskualifikasi; plagiarisme/private diskualifikasi.
- Deploy tidak boleh ditunda; tiap akhir slice app jalan & bisa didemokan.
- Konflik dengan spesifikasi resmi: spesifikasi lomba menang; sebutkan konfliknya.

## Stack (final)
- Backend: Laravel + Octane (SWOOLE), MySQL, Redis, Sanctum SPA, spatie (permission, query-builder, activitylog), league/csv; Pest, Pint, Debugbar (dev). Dev: php artisan serve; Octane di akhir.
- Frontend: React+Vite (JS/JSX, tanpa TS), React Router, Zustand, TanStack Query, RHF+Zod, Axios, dayjs, JSZip, DOMPurify, react-virtual, Bootstrap 5.3 CSS, error-boundary, Vitest; toast & ikon buatan sendiri; MathML native.
- Realtime: Node ESM, Fastify, ioredis, SSE (tanpa WebSocket); dev node --watch.
- Dilarang: TypeScript, Laravel Excel, zip.js, Lucide, Sonner, clsx, KaTeX, Larastan, Socket.IO, NestJS, RoadRunner. Dep lain: justifikasi 1 kalimat.

## Prinsip keamanan (do not trust client)
1. Role/user_id/waktu/urutan/skor ditentukan server; guru/admin tak bisa self-register.
2. Laravel = otoritas bisnis; DB sumber kebenaran; Redis cache/state; file di luar public.
3. Jawaban DB dulu lalu cache; hapus bertahap (DB → Redis → L1 → job fisik).
4. Acak soal/opsi di server per attempt; kunci jawaban tak pernah ke klien.
5. deadline_at dihitung server; timer klien hanya tampilan.
6. Submit idempoten; Policy di tiap endpoint (anti IDOR).
7. Mutasi sensitif: auth+permission+alasan+token sekali pakai+audit append-only.
8. Gagal penilaian per soal tak menjatuhkan ulangan; tanpa 500 mentah.
9. Sinyal kecurangan = bahan tinjauan, bukan vonis.
10. Anti-enumeration + throttle; cookie aman; CSP; whitelist redirect; password ≥10, Argon2id.
11. Akun suspended/unverified/deleted ditolak di semua jalur.
12. Tanpa rahasia di log/resp API.

## Pagar mutu
- JSDoc + checkJs strict; data luar selalu Zod.
- PHP strict_types, enum, FormRequest, Policy, API Resource, shouldBeStrict non-prod.
- DB: FK, NOT NULL, unique (attempt aktif; jawaban per soal), transaksi + lockForUpdate.
- ESLint (react-hooks, no-danger); arch test (tanpa dd/dump; controller tak panggil DB:: langsung); Factory+Seeder.
- verify.sh: php artisan test, pint --test, npm run check, eslint, vitest. Hijau tiap akhir slice.

## Cara kerja
- Slice 00..10 berurutan; berhenti & lapor tiap akhir slice; commit kecil per langkah.
- Anggaran prompt: p1 struktur+slice00; p2 slice01-03; p3 slice04-06; p4 slice07-09; p5 slice10+deploy.
- Potong bila mepet: cache L1, xlsx, mode gelap, mode tim, AI, rekam diri, avatar, layar guru.
- Tak boleh dipotong: deploy hidup, Octane Swoole (atau catatan jujur), keamanan inti, jurnal+log jujur.

## Format laporan tiap slice
(a) selesai (b) diuji + hasil (c) risiko/keputusan (d) langkah berikutnya; daftar berkas dibuat/diubah; migrasi; test; bukti perintah+output.

## Larangan
- Token/data sensitif di localStorage (kecuali cadangan jawaban tanpa kunci); percaya klien; kunci jawaban/alasan AI ke murid; placeholder/TODO; kripto buatan sendiri; dep di luar daftar; mengubah riwayat git.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
fail=0
run() { name; shift; if "$@"; then echo OK; else echo FAIL; fail=1; fi }
run "backend pest" (cd backend && php artisan test)
run "pint" (cd backend && ./vendor/bin/pint --test)
run "frontend check" (cd frontend && npm run check)
run "frontend eslint" (cd frontend && npm run lint)
run "frontend vitest" (cd frontend && npm run test -- run)  # vitest run
run "realtime test" (cd realtime && npm test)
exit $fail
```

Move the DB check to a service: App\Sections\Health\Services\HealthService with method report(): array — controller calls service only. That fits architecture beautifully.

Then toOnlyUse whitelist: ['App\Sections\Services', 'App\Http\Controllers', 'Illuminate\Http', 'Illuminate\Routing'] — HealthController uses: App\Http\Controllers\Controller ✓, Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse ✓, App\Sections\Health\Services\HealthService ✗ — namespace App\Sections\Health\Services is not 'App\Sections\Services' (string prefix mismatch!).

Pest toOnlyUse: "expect('App\Sections\Http\Controllers')->toOnlyUse([...])" — does it do namespace-prefix matching or exact class matching? Pest docs: toOnlyUse() expects the target to only use the given namespaces — it matches namespace prefixes I believe. E.g. ->toOnlyUse(['Illuminate\Http']) allows Illuminate\Http\Request etc. It uses Str::startsWith on the class dependencies. So 'App\Sections' prefix would allow App\Sections\Health\Services. 

So whitelist: ['App\Sections', 'App\Http\Controllers', 'Illuminate\Http', 'Illuminate\Routing'] — 'App\Sections' prefix covers services of all sections. And blocks Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB, Illuminate\Database etc. But also blocks Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route (controllers don't need). OK.

Hmm wait — but 'App\Sections' prefix also allows App\Sections\...Models — controllers shouldn't use models directly either per strict architecture, but let's not over-engineer; rule intent: no DB facade, no direct DB:: calls. export const useToastStore = create((set, get) => ({

  push: (toast) => {
    const id = ++seq
    set((s) => ({ toasts: [...s.toasts, { id, ...toast }] }))

}))

main.jsx:
```jsx
import { StrictMode } from 'react'
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client'
import { BrowserRouter } from 'react-router-dom'
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { ErrorBoundary } from 'react-error-boundary'
import 'bootstrap/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css'
import './theme/theme.css'
import App from './App.jsx'

const container = document.getElementById('root')
if (!container) throw new Error('Elemen #root tidak ditemukan')
const queryClient = new QueryClient({ defaultOptions: { queries: { retry: 1 } } })

createRoot(container).render(
  <StrictMode>
    <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
      <BrowserRouter>
        <ErrorBoundary fallback={<div role="alert">Terjadi kesalahan...</div>}>
          <App />
        </ErrorBoundary>
      </BrowserRouter>
    </QueryClientProvider>
  </StrictMode>,
)
```

client.js:
```js
import axios from 'axios'

export const client = axios.create({
  baseURL: import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL ?? '/api',
  withCredentials: true,
  headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },
})

let redirecting = false
client.interceptors.response.use(
  (res) => res,
  (err) => {
    const status = err?.response?.status
    if ((status === 401 || status === 419) && !redirecting) { ... window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('auth:unauthorized')) }
    if (status === 429) { seconds from header Retry-After; dispatch 'ratelimit' }
    return Promise.reject(err)
  },
)
export async function getCsrfCookie() { return client.get('/sanctum/csrf-cookie') }
```

health.js:
```js
import { z } from 'zod'
import { client } from './client.js'

export const zHealthResponse = z.object({ ok: z.literal(true), service: z.string(), database: z.boolean(), time: z.string() })

export async function getHealth() {
  const res = await client.get('/v1/health')
  return zHealthResponse.parse(res.data)  // data dari luar selalu lewat Zod
}
```

```js
import Fastify from 'fastify'
import Redis from 'ioredis'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'

export function buildApp(options = {}) {
  const app = Fastify({ logger: options.logger ?? true })
  const redis = new Redis(process.env.REDIS_URL ?? 'redis://127.0.0.1:6379', { lazyConnect: true, maxRetriesPerRequest: 1, retryStrategy: () => null? })
  ...
}
```
ioredis v6 — import Redis from 'ioredis' (default export). lazyConnect true → no connection until .connect() or command. For /ready: try await redis.ping() with catch → redis: 'down'. But if lazyConnect and we never connect, ping() triggers connect attempt → could hang? With retryStrategy null and maxRetriesPerRequest 1 + connectTimeout small (1000), catch returns 'down'. Simpler: don't auto-ping; report status: redis.status ('waiting' when lazy not connected). /ready returns { ok: true, service: 'realtime', redis: redis.status, time }. Test expects ok true + redis field present. No network needed. Clean and fail-open. Also close redis on close hook (app.addHook('onClose', () => redis.disconnect())).

Health route: GET /health → { ok: true, service: 'realtime', time: new Date().toISOString() }.

export-word.sh: 
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"  # docs/
ROOT=$(cd .. && pwd)
OUT="$ROOT/docs/word"; mkdir -p "$OUT"
export_file() { src="$1"; dst="$2"; ... }
if command -v pandoc >/dev/null; then
  pandoc "$ROOT/AGENT.md" -o "$OUT/AGENT.docx"
  pandoc jurnal-prompt.md -o word/jurnal-prompt.docx
  # log mentah: gabung verbatim
  tmp=$(mktemp); for f in log-mentah/*.md; do echo; echo "---"; echo "BERKAS: $f"; echo; cat "$f"; echo; done >> "$tmp" ... pandoc "$tmp" -o word/log-mentah.docx
  pandoc catatan-demo.md -o word/catatan-demo.docx
else
  python3 export_docx.py ...  # python-docx
fi
```

TS7006: create((set) => ({...})) — parameter set/state/t implicit any karena zustand versi baru mungkin kehilangan inferensi tanpa generik eksplisit di JS? create dari zustand v5 seharusnya menginfer... Kemungkinan: karena tsc tidak bisa menginfer tipe callback tanpa konteks ketika mengembalikan object literal dengan metode? Seharusnya bisa. Masalahnya mungkin versi zustand v6 yang mengubah tipe create.

Solusi paling sederhana: tulis store dengan JSDoc @param eksplisit:

/**
 * @typedef {import('zustand').StateCreator<ToastState>} ToastCreator
 */
@typedef ToastState = { toasts: Toast[], push: ..., dismiss: ... }
export const useToastStore = create()(/** @type {ToastCreator} */ ((set) => ({ ... })))

Pattern zustand v5 curried: create()(fn) untuk TypeScript. Dalam JS, create(fn) masih jalan runtime, tapi untuk tipe, pakai create()(fn) dengan @type pada fn.

Beri tipe eksplisit:
/**
 * @typedef {{ toasts: import('./toast.js').Toast[], push: (t: Omit<Toast,'id'>) => number, dismiss: (id: number) => void }} ToastState
 */
export const useToastStore = create()(/** @type {import('zustand').StateCreator<ToastState, [], []>} */ (fn))

Hmm rumit. Alternatif: tambahkan anotasi parameter langsung:
create(/** @type {(set: (fn: (s: ToastState) => Partial<ToastState>) => void) => ToastState} */ ((set) => ({...})))

Letak kerumitan. Cara paling pragmatis dan tetap jujur terhadap pagar mutu (checkJs strict): tulis creator dengan parameter bertipe via JSDoc:

/**
 * @typedef {{ toasts: Toast[], push: (t: Omit<Toast, 'id'>) => number, dismiss: (id: number) => void }} ToastState
 */

/**
 * @param {(updater: (state: ToastState) => Partial<ToastState>) => void} set
 * @returns {ToastState}
 */
function buatStoreToast(set) {
  return {
    toasts: [],
    push: (toast) => { ... },
    dismiss: (id) => set((state) => ({ toasts: state.toasts.filter((t) => t.id !== id) })),
  }
}
export const useToastStore = create(buatStoreToast)

Semua parameter terinfer dari anotasi buatStoreToast. ToastLine 95: ToastItem useToastStore((s) => s.dismiss) — s implicit any karena useToastStore tipenya... jika create mendapat ToastState, hook typenya juga ToastState → s typed. 

Also line 95 in toast.jsx: `const dismiss = useToastStore((s) => s.dismiss)` — s implicit any error. Dengan typed creator, terpecahkan.

Juga `push: (toast) => {...}` parameter toast implicit any → anotasi di buatStoreToast: push: (/** @type {Omit<Toast,'id'>} */ toast) => ... — dengan return type ToastState ter-annotate, contextual typing mengisi parameter. Seharusnya OK.

  await expect(client.get('/v1/x', { adapter })).rejects.toBeDefined()
  expect(window.dispatchEvent).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1) // tidak loop
})
```

import { client } from './client.js'

it('401 memicu event auth:sesi-habis', async () => {
  const spy = vi.fn()
  vi.stubGlobal('window', { dispatchEvent: spy })
  const asli = client.defaults.adapter
  client.defaults.adapter = async () => { throw buatGalatAxios(401) }
  await expect(client.get('/v1/x')).rejects.toBeTruthy()
  client.defaults.adapter = asli
  expect(spy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ type: 'auth:sesi-habis' }))
})
```

}

Controller addition — imports: add KirimUlangVerifikasiPublikRequest + User query. Write code:

```php
/**
 * Kirim ulang tautan verifikasi dari halaman publik (akun pending belum bisa masuk).
 * Respons selalu identik agar tidak bisa dipakai menebak email terdaftar.
 */
public function kirimUlangVerifikasiPublik(
    KirimUlangVerifikasiPublikRequest $request,
    VerifyEmailService $verifikasi,
): JsonResponse {
    $user = User::query()->where('email', mb_strtolower((string) $request->input('email')))->first();

    if ($user !== null && $user->status === UserStatus::Pending && ! $user->hasVerifiedEmail()) {
        $verifikasi->kirimUlang($user);
    }

    return response()->json(['message' => 'Jika email tersebut terdaftar dan belum terverifikasi, tautan verifikasi baru telah dikirim.']);
}
```
Import UserStatus + User. Controller currently imports User already. Add `use App\Sections\Auth\Enums\UserStatus;`.

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Sections\Auth\Http\Requests;

use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;

class KirimUlangVerifikasiPublikRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, list<string>|string>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        return [
            'email' => ['required', 'string', 'email:rfc', 'max:120'],
        ];
    }

    protected function prepareForValidation(): void
    {
        $this->merge([
            'email' => mb_strtolower(trim((string) $this->input('email'))),
        ]);
    }
}

  id: z.number(),
  name: z.string(),
  email: z.string(),
  role: z.string(),
  status: z.string(),
  statusLabel: z.string(),
  emailTerverifikasi: z.boolean(),
})

/** Skema respons login. */
export const skemaResponMasuk = z.object({ message: z.string(), user: skemaUser })

/** Skema respons berbentuk pesan. */
export const skemaPesan = z.object({ message: z.string() })

/** Skema respons diagnostik sesi. */

authStore.js:
```js
import { create } from 'zustand'
import { resetStatusKeluar } from '../../shared/api/client.js'
import { tampilkanToast } from '../../shared/ui/toast.jsx'

/**
 * @typedef {import('./api/auth.js').DataUser} DataUser
 * @typedef {{
 *   user: DataUser | null,
 *   detikThrottle: number,
 *   simpanUser: (user: DataUser) => void,
 *   bersihkan: () => void,
 *   setDetikThrottle: (detik: number) => void,
 * }} AuthState
 */

/** @param {(updater: (state: AuthState) => Partial<AuthState>) => void} set */
function buatStoreAuth(set) {
  return {
    user: null,
    detikThrottle: 0,
    simpanUser: (user) => set({ user }),
    bersihkan: () => set({ user: null }),
    setDetikThrottle: (detik) => set({ detikThrottle: detik }),
  }
}

export const useAuthStore = create()(
  /** @type {import('zustand').StateCreator<AuthState, [], []>} */ (buatStoreAuth),
)

/**
 * Pasang listener event sesi (401/419 dan 429) — dipasang sekali di root.
 * @param {(path: string, opsi?: { replace?: boolean }) => void} navigasi
 * @returns {() => void} pembersih listener
 */
export function pasangAuthListeners(navigasi) {
  const saatSesiHabis = () => {
    useAuthStore.getState().bersihkan()
    resetStatusKeluar() // event sudah diproses; 401 berikutnya boleh memicu lagi
    tampilkanToast('info', 'Sesi kamu berakhir. Silakan masuk kembali.')
    navigasi('/masuk', { replace: true })
  }
  const saatThrottle = (peristiwa) => {
    const detail = /** @type {{ detik?: number } | undefined} */ (peristiwa?.detail)
    const detik = detail?.detik ?? 0
    useAuthStore.getState().setDetikThrottle(detik)
    tampilkanToast('peringatan', detik > 0 ? `Terlalu banyak percobaan. Coba lagi dalam ${detik} detik.` : 'Terlalu banyak percobaan. Tunggu sebentar.')
  }
  window.addEventListener('auth:sesi-habis', saatSesiHabis)
  window.addEventListener('auth:throttle', saatThrottle)
  return () => {
    window.removeEventListener('auth:sesi-habis', saatSesiHabis)
    window.removeEventListener('auth:throttle', saatThrottle)
  }
}
```

Form submit:
```jsx
const onSubmit = handleSubmit(async (data) => {
  try {
    const respon = await masuk(data)
    simpanUser(respon.user)
    tampilkanToast('sukses', `Selamat datang, ${respon.user.name}!`)
    navigasi('/', { replace: true })
  } catch (galat) {
    const pesan = /** @type {any} */ (galat)?.response?.data?.message
    setError('root', { message: pesan ?? 'Tidak dapat terhubung ke server. Coba lagi.' })
  }
})
```
eslint no-unused-vars fine. `/** @type {any} */` — checkJs with strict: `any` allowed? jsconfig strict doesn't ban any. OK. Actually cleaner: `galat?.response?.data?.message` without cast — tsc infers any from axios? galat is unknown in catch → accessing .response errors in strict TS ("'galat' is of type 'unknown'"). checkJs treats catch var as unknown too (useUnknownInCatchVariables under strict). So need cast: `const g = /** @type {{ response?: { data?: { message?: string } } }} */ (galat)`. Use that pattern everywhere.

/**
 * API auth slice 01 — semua data dari server divalidasi Zod dulu.
 * Sesi cookie SPA (HttpOnly) — tidak ada token di localStorage/sessionStorage.
 */
import { z } from 'zod'
import { ambilCsrfCookie, client } from '../../shared/api/client.js'

/** Skema user dari UserResource (tanpa kolom sensitif). */
export const skemaUser = z.object({
  id: z.number(),
  name: z.string(),
  email: z.string(),
  role: z.string(),
  status: z.string(),
  statusLabel: z.string(),
  emailTerverifikasi: z.boolean(),
})

/** Skema respons berisi pesan. */
export const skemaPesan = z.object({ message: z.string() })

/** Skema respons diagnostik sesi. */
export const skemaSesi = z.object({ terautentikasi: z.boolean() })

/**
 * Ambil pesan galat yang ramah tampil dari error axios.
 * @param {unknown} galat
 * @param {string} bawaan
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function pesanGalat(galat, bawaan) {
  const respons = /** @type {any} */ (galat)?.response
  const pesan = respons?.data?.message
  return typeof pesan === 'string' && pesan !== '' ? pesan : bawaan
}

/**
 * Ambil galat validasi per field dari respons 422.
 * @param {unknown} galat
 * @returns {Record<string, string>}
 */
export function galatPerField(galat) {
  const errors = /** @type {any} */ (galat)?.response?.data?.errors
  if (errors === null || typeof errors !== 'object') return {}
  /** @type {Record<string, string>} */
  const hasil = {}
  for (const [kunci, nilai] of Object.entries(errors)) {
    if (Array.isArray(nilai) && typeof nilai[0] === 'string') hasil[kunci] = nilai[0]
  }
  return hasil
}
...

  return skemaPesan.parse(respons.data)

export function pasangListenerAuth() {
  /** @param {Event} event */
  const saatSesiHabis = () => {
    resetStatusKeluar()
    useAuthStore.getState().tandaiKeluar()
    tampilkanToast('info', 'Sesi berakhir. Silakan masuk lagi.')
  }
  /** @param {Event} event */
  const saatThrottle = (event) => {
    const detik = /** @type {CustomEvent<{detik?:number}>} */ (event).detail?.detik ?? 0
    useAuthStore.getState().mulaiThrottle(detik)
  }
  globalThis.addEventListener('auth:sesi-habis', saatSesiHabis)
  globalThis.addEventListener('auth:throttle', saatThrottle)
  return () => {
    globalThis.removeEventListener('auth:sesi-habis', saatSesiHabis)
    globalThis.removeEventListener('auth:throttle', saatThrottle)
  }
}

export function sisaDetik(throttleSampai, sekarang = Date.now()) {
  const sisa = Math.ceil((throttleSampai - sekarang) / 1000)
  return sisa > 0 ? sisa : 0
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
export function gunakanThrottle() {
  const throttleSampai = useAuthStore((s) => s.throttleSampai)
  const [sekarang, setSekarang] = useState(() => Date.now())
  useEffect(() => {
    if (throttleSampai <= 0) return
    const timer = setInterval(() => setSekarang(Date.now()), 1000)
    return () => clearInterval(timer)
  }, [throttleSampai])
  return sisaDetik(throttleSampai, sekarang)
}
```

}

Error extraction helper:
```js
/** Ambil pesan galat pertama dari respons 422 Laravel, atau pesan generik. */
export function ambilPesanGalat(galat) {
  const data = galat?.response?.data
  if (data?.errors) {
    const pertama = Object.values(data.errors)[0]
    if (Array.isArray(pertama) && pertama[0]) return String(pertama[0])
  }
  if (typeof data?.message === 'string' && data.message) return data.message
  return 'Terjadi kesalahan. Coba lagi.'
}
```

  return {
    user: null,
    statusTerkini: 'tak-tahu',
    throttleDetik: 0,
    aturUser: (user) => set({ user, statusTerkini: user ? 'masuk' : 'keluar' }),
    tandaiSesiHabis: () => set({ user: null, statusTerkini: 'keluar' }),
    mulaiThrottle: (detik) => set({ throttleDetik: detik }),
    kurangiThrottle: () => set((s) => ({ throttleDetik: Math.max(0, s.throttleDetik - 1) })),
  }
}

Hmm — simpler: store actions themselves are the pure-ish handlers; test via `useAuthStore.getState().tandaiSesiHabis()` etc. And `pasangListenerAuth()` wires window events:

```js
/** Pasang listener event global dari interceptor axios. Kembalikan fungsi pembersih. */
export function pasangListenerAuth() {
  const saatSesiHabis = () => useAuthStore.getState().tandaiSesiHabis()
  const saatThrottle = (event) => {
    const detik = Number(event?.detail?.detik) || 0
    useAuthStore.getState().mulaiThrottle(detik)
  }
  window.addEventListener('auth:sesi-habis', saatSesiHabis)
  window.addEventListener('auth:throttle', saatThrottle)
  return () => {
    window.removeEventListener('auth:sesi-habis', saatSesiHabis)
    window.removeEventListener('auth:throttle', saatThrottle)
  }
}
```

For test in node env: window doesn't exist → don't call pasangListenerAuth in tests. Test store actions + a pure `detikDariDetail(detail)` helper:
```js
export function detikDariDetail(detail) {
  const detik = Number(detail?.detik)
  return Number.isFinite(detik) && detik > 0 ? detik : 0
}
```

```jsx
function PengamatAuth() {
  const statusTerkini = useAuthStore((s) => s.statusTerkini)
  const sebelumnya = useRef(statusTerkini)
  useEffect(() => { return pasangListenerAuth() }, [])
  useEffect(() => {

      tampilkanToast('info', 'Sesi berakhir. Silakan masuk lagi.')
    }
    sebelumnya.current = statusTerkini
  }, [statusTerkini])
  return null
}

import { create } from 'zustand'

/** @typedef {import('../api/auth.js').User} User */

/**
 * @typedef {{
 *   user: User | null,
 *   statusMuat: 'idle' | 'memuat' | 'siap' | 'tamu',
 *   aturUser: (user: User | null) => void,
 *   muatSesi: () => Promise<void>,
 *   keluar: () => Promise<void>,
 * }} AuthState
 */

export const useAuthStore = create()(/** @type {import('zustand').StateCreator<AuthState, [], []>} */ ((set) => ({
  user: null,
  statusMuat: 'idle',
  aturUser: (user) => set({ user, statusMuat: user ? 'siap' : 'tamu' }),
  muatSesi: async () => {
    set({ statusMuat: 'memuat' })
    try {
      const user = await ambilSaya()
      set({ user, statusMuat: 'siap' })
    } catch {
      set({ user: null, statusMuat: 'tamu' })
    }
  },
  keluar: async () => {
    try { await keluar() } catch { /* abaikan: sesi mungkin sudah habis */ }
    set({ user: null, statusMuat: 'tamu' })
  },
})))
```

hooks/gunakanAuthEvents.js:
```js
import { useEffect } from 'react'
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'
import { resetStatusKeluar } from '../../../shared/api/client.js'
import { tampilkanToast } from '../../../shared/ui/toast.jsx'
import { useAuthStore } from '../stores/authStore.js'

export function gunakanAuthEvents() {
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const keluar = useAuthStore((s) => s.keluar)

  useEffect(() => {
    /** Sesuaidatang sesi habis (401/419) */
    function saatSesiHabis() {
      keluar()
      tampilkanToast('peringatan', 'Sesi berakhir. Silakan masuk lagi.')
      navigate('/masuk', { replace: true })
      resetStatusKeluar()
    }
    /** @param {Event} acara */
    function saatThrottle(acara) {
      const detail = /** @type {CustomEvent<{detik?: number}>} */ (acara)
      const detik = detail.detail?.detik ?? 0
      tampilkanToast('peringatan', detik > 0 ? `Terlalu sering. Coba lagi dalam ${detik} detik.` : 'Terlalu sering mencoba. Tunggu sebentar lagi.')
    }
    window.addEventListener('auth:sesi-habis', saatSesiHabis)
    window.addEventListener('auth:throttle', saatThrottle)
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('auth:sesi-habis', saatSesiHabis)
      window.removeEventListener('auth:throttle', saatThrottle)
    }
  }, [keluar, navigate])
}
```
Careful: saatSesiHabis calling keluar() → api keluar POST → which if 401 re-fires event... but sedangKeluar=true guard prevents; and we reset after. Also POST /keluar with expired session → 401 → event fires but guarded. OK. But calling api POST keluar in sesi-habis is unnecessary — just clear store state without API call: use aturUser(null). Better: `useAuthStore.getState().aturUser(null)` — avoids network. I'll add `aturluUser` usage instead of keluar(). Hmm but keluar also fine... simpler no-network: aturUser(null).

### Three-layer settings

Table `settings`:
- id
- scope (enum: sekolah, kelas, kuis)

Actually the lock concept: "kuis > kelas > sekolah kecuali sekolah menandai locked". So resolution order: quiz → class → school; BUT if school has the key with locked=true, then school's value wins (lower layers ignored). So:

resolve(key, schoolId, classId, quizId):
- if school setting exists and locked → return school value
- else if quiz setting exists → quiz
- else if class setting exists → class
- else if school setting exists → school
- else default from a registry of known keys.

Caching: cache resolved settings per school/class/quiz, keyed. Invalidate on change: when a setting changes, forget relevant cache keys. Simplest robust approach: cache key includes a version/nonce; or cache each scope's setting map and compute resolution in PHP from cached maps. That way invalidating "all settings for scope X" is a single forget, and resolution is done in code.

- `PengaturanService::untuk($schoolId, $classId = null, $quizId = null): array` returns resolved map.
- Internally loads maps: `cache()->rememberForever("pengaturan:sekolah:{$schoolId}", fn() => ...)`, `pengaturan:kelas:{$classId}`, `pengaturan:kuis:{$quizId}`. Then resolve in PHP, cache the resolved result under `pengaturan:resolved:...`? Keep it simple: cache scope maps; resolution is cheap.

Invalidation: `lupakanScope(scope, id)` forgets the scope map cache. Test: change setting → assert cache forgotten / new value returned.

PengaturanService:
```php
class PengaturanService
{
  public const PREFIX = 'pengaturan';

  /** @return array<string,mixed> peta kunci=>nilai untuk satu lingkup */
  private function peta(string $lingkup, int $id): array
  {
     $key = self::kunciCache($lingkup,$id);
     return Cache::rememberForever($key, function () use ($lingkup,$id) {
        $baris = Pengaturan::query()->where('lingkup',$lingkup)->where('lingkup_id',$id)->get();
        $nilai = []; $terkunci = [];
        foreach ($baris as $b) { $nilai[$b->kunci] = $b->nilai; if ($b->terkunci) $terkunci[$b->kunci]=true; }
        return ['nilai'=>$nilai,'terkunci'=>$terkunci];
     });
  }

  public function semua(int $sekolahId, ?int $kelasId=null, ?int $kuisId=null): array
  {
     $sekolah = $this->peta(LingkupPengaturan::Sekolah->value, $sekolahId);
     $kelas = $kelasId ? $this->peta(LingkupPengaturan::Kelas->value,$kelasId) : ['nilai'=>[],'terkunci'=>[]];
     $kuis = $kuisId ? $this->peta(LingkupPengaturan::Kuis->value,$kuisId) : ['nilai'=>[],'terkunci'=>[]];
     $hasil = [];
     foreach (KunciPengaturan::cases() as $kunci) {
        $k = $kunci->value;
        $sumber = 'bawaan'; $nilai = $kunci->bawaan();
        if (array_key_exists($k,$sekolah['nilai'])) { $nilai=$sekolah['nilai'][$k]; $sumber='sekolah'; }
        if (isset($sekolah['terkunci'][$k])) {
           // sekolah mengunci → abaikan lapis bawah
        } else {
           if (array_key_exists($k,$kelas['nilai'])) { $nilai=$kelas['nilai'][$k]; $sumber='kelas'; }
           if (array_key_exists($k,$kuis['nilai'])) { $nilai=$kuis['nilai'][$k]; $sumber='kuis'; }
        }
        $hasil[$k] = [
           'nilai'=>$nilai,
           'tipe'=>$kunci->tipe(),
           'label'=>$kunci->label(),
           'kelompok'=>$kunci->kelompok(),
           'bawaan'=>$kunci->bawaan(),
           'sumber'=>$sumber,
           'terkunci'=>isset($sekolah['terkunci'][$k]),
        ];
     }
     return [
        'sekolah_id'=>$sekolahId,
        'kelas_id'=>$kelasId,
        'kuis_id'=>$kuisId,
        'pengaturan'=>$hasil,
     ];
  }

  public function simpan(LingkupPengaturan $lingkup, int $lingkupId, KunciPengaturan $kunci, bool|int $nilai, bool $terkunci=false): Pengaturan
  {
     $p = Pengaturan::query()->updateOrCreate(
        ['lingkup'=>$lingkup->value,'lingkup_id'=>$lingkupId,'kunci'=>$kunci->value],
        ['nilai'=>$nilai,'terkunci'=>$terkunci && $lingkup===LingkupPengaturan::Sekolah],
     );
     $this->lupakan($lingkup,$lingkupId);
     return $p;
  }

  public function lupakan(LingkupPengaturan $lingkup, int $id): void
  {
     Cache::forget(self::kunciCache($lingkup->value,$id));
  }

  private static function kunciCache(string $lingkup,int $id): string { return self::PREFIX.":{$lingkup}:{$id}"; }
}
```

private function prosesBatch(array $batch, int $sekolahId, Collection $kelasMap): void
{
    DB::transaction(function () use ($batch,$sekolahId,$kelasMap) {
        $emails = array_map(fn($r)=>$r['email'],$batch);
        $users = User::query()->with('murid')->whereIn('email',$emails)->get()->keyBy('email');
        $roleMurid = Role::findOrCreate('murid','web');
        foreach ($batch as $row) {
            $user = $users->get($row['email']);
            if ($user === null) {
                $user = User::query()->create([
                    'name'=>$row['nama'],
                    'email'=>$row['email'],
                    'password'=>Hash::make($row['kata_sandi'] ?? Str::password(16)),
                    'status'=>UserStatus::Aktif->value,
                    'role'=>'murid',
                    'email_verified_at'=>now(),
                ]);
                $user->assignRole($roleMurid);
                $users->put($row['email'], $user->load('murid'));
            } else {
                if (! $user->hasRole('murid')) { ... error? } 
                $user->forceFill(['name'=>$row['nama']])->save();
            }
            $kelas = $kelasMap[$row['kelas']]; // resolved earlier lowercase
            Murid::query()->updateOrCreate(
                ['user_id'=>$user->id],
                ['school_id'=>$sekolahId,'class_id'=>$kelas->id,'nis'=>$row['nis'],'nisn'=>$row['nisn']],
            );
        }
    });
}

namespace App\Sections\School\Services;

class SekolahService
{
    public function tunggal(): Sekolah
    {
        return Sekolah::query()->orderBy('id')->firstOrFail();
    }

    /** @param array<string,mixed> $data */
    public function perbarui(array $data): Sekolah
    {
        $sekolah = $this->tunggal();
        $sekolah->fill($data)->save();
        return $sekolah->refresh();
    }
}
```

ImporMuridService. Let me write it fully.

```php
namespace App\Sections\School\Services;

use App\Models\User;
use App\Sections\Auth\Enums\UserStatus;
use App\Sections\School\Models\Kelas;
use App\Sections\School\Models\Murid;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Validator;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use League\Csv\Reader;
use Spatie\Permission\Models\Role;

class ImporMuridService
{
    public const BATAS_GALAT = 100;
    public const UKURAN_BATCH = 500;

    private const KOLOM_WAJIB = ['nama', 'email', 'kelas'];
    private const KOLOM_DIKENAL = ['nama', 'email', 'kelas', 'nis', 'nisn', 'kata_sandi'];

    /**
     * Impor murid dari berkas CSV.
     *
     * @return array{total:int, sukses:int, gagal:int, dihentikan:bool, batas_galat:int, galat:list<array{baris:int, pesan:string}>}
     */
    public function impor(string $path, int $sekolahId): array
    {
        $reader = Reader::createFromPath($path, 'r');
        $reader->setHeaderOffset(0);
        $reader->skipEmptyRecords();

        $header = $this->normalisasiHeader($reader->getHeader());
        $this->pastikanHeader($header);

        $kolom = array_flip($header); // nama kolom => index

        $kelasMap = Kelas::query()
            ->where('school_id', $sekolahId)
            ->get()
            ->keyBy(fn (Kelas $k) => mb_strtolower($k->nama));

        $muridAda = Murid::query()
            ->with('user')
            ->where('school_id', $sekolahId)
            ->get();
        $muridPerNis = $muridAda->filter(fn ($m) => $m->nis !== null)->keyBy('nis');
        $peranMurid = Role::findOrCreate('murid', 'web');

        $galat = [];
        $sukses = 0;
        $total = 0;
        $dihentikan = false;
        $nisTerpakai = [];
        $emailTerpakai = [];
        $batch = [];

        foreach ($reader->getRecords() as $record) {
            $total++;
            $nomorBaris = $total + 1; // baris 1 = header

            $baris = $this->barisDariRecord($record, $kolom);

            $pesan = $this->validasiBaris($baris, $sekolahId, $kelasMap, $muridPerNis, $nisTerpakai, $emailTerpakai);

            if ($pesan !== null) {
                $galat[] = ['baris' => $nomorBaris, 'pesan' => $pesan];
                if (count($galat) >= self::BATAS_GALAT) {
                    $dihentikan = true;
                    break;
                }
                continue;
            }

            if ($baris['nis'] !== null) {
                $nisTerpakai[$baris['nis']] = true;
            }
            $emailTerpakai[$baris['email']] = true;

            $batch[] = $baris;
            if (count($batch) >= self::UKURAN_BATCH) {
                $sukses += $this->prosesBatch($batch, $sekolahId, $kelasMap, $peranMurid);
                $batch = [];
            }
        }

        if ($batch !== []) {
            $sukses += $this->prosesBatch($batch, $sekolahId, $kelasMap, $peranMurid);
        }

        return [
            'total' => $total,
            'sukses' => $sukses,
            'gagal' => count($galat),
            'dihentikan' => $dihentikan,
            'batas_galat' => self::BATAS_GALAT,
            'galat' => $galat,
        ];
    }
```

```php
private function prosesBatch(array $batch, int $sekolahId, Collection $kelasMap, Role $peranMurid): int
{
    $jumlah = 0;
    DB::transaction(function () use ($batch, $sekolahId, $kelasMap, $peranMurid, &$jumlah): void {
        $emails = array_column($batch, 'email');
        $users = User::query()->whereIn('email', $emails)->get()->keyBy('email');

        foreach ($batch as $baris) {
            $user = $users->get($baris['email']);

            if ($user === null) {
                $user = User::query()->create([
                    'name' => $baris['nama'],
                    'email' => $baris['email'],
                    'password' => Hash::make($baris['kata_sandi'] ?? Str::password(16)),
                    'status' => UserStatus::Aktif->value,
                    'role' => 'murid',
                    'email_verified_at' => now(),
                ]);
                $user->assignRole($peranMurid);
                $users->put($baris['email'], $user);
            } elseif ($user->name !== $baris['nama']) {
                $user->forceFill(['name' => $baris['nama']])->save();
            }

            $kelas = $kelasMap->get(mb_strtolower($baris['kelas']));

            Murid::query()->updateOrCreate(
                ['user_id' => $user->getKey()],
                [
                    'school_id' => $sekolahId,
                    'class_id' => $kelas->getKey(),
                    'nis' => $baris['nis'],
                    'nisn' => $baris['nisn'],
                ],
            );

            $jumlah++;
        }
    });

    return $jumlah;
}
```

Concern: `$peranMurid` obtained via `Role::findOrCreate` outside transaction — fine.

Concern: `preventLazyLoading` — `$user->name` fine. `$kelas->getKey()` fine.

Concern: hashing 500 with bcrypt cost 4 fast.

```php
namespace App\Sections\School\Services;

use App\Sections\School\Models\Murid;
use League\Csv\Writer;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\StreamedResponse;

class EksporMuridService
{
    /** Sel CSV yang berawalan = + - @ diamankan agar tidak dieksekusi spreadsheet. */
    public static function amankanSel(?string $nilai): string
    {
        $nilai = (string) $nilai;
        if ($nilai !== '' && in_array($nilai[0], ['=', '+', '-', '@'], true)) {
            return "'".$nilai;
        }
        return $nilai;
    }

    public function ekspor(int $sekolahId): StreamedResponse
    {
        $namaBerkas = 'murid-'.now()->format('Ymd-His').'.csv';

        return response()->streamDownload(function () use ($sekolahId): void {
            $keluaran = fopen('php://output', 'w');
            if ($keluaran === false) {
                return;
            }
            $writer = Writer::createFromStream($keluaran);
            $writer->insertOne(['nis', 'nisn', 'nama', 'email', 'kelas']);

            Murid::query()
                ->with(['user', 'kelas'])
                ->where('school_id', $sekolahId)
                ->orderBy('id')
                ->chunk(200, function ($murid) use ($writer): void {
                    foreach ($murid as $m) {
                        $writer->insertOne([
                            self::amankanSel($m->nis),
                            self::amankanSel($m->nisn),
                            self::amankanSel($m->user->name),
                            self::amankanSel($m->user->email),
                            self::amankanSel($m->kelas->nama),
                        ]);
                    }
                });

            fclose($keluaran);
        }, $namaBerkas, ['Content-Type' => 'text/csv; charset=UTF-8']);
    }
}
```
`response()` helper in a service is fine (not controller). But better return StreamedResponse and let controller call. Using global `response()` in service is acceptable. Hmm, arch test restricts controllers only. Fine.

Actually `chunk` with eager load is fine; `preventLazyLoading` satisfied.

MuridService:
```php
namespace App\Sections\School\Services;

use App\Models\User;
use App\Sections\Auth\Enums\UserStatus;
use App\Sections\School\Models\Kelas;
use App\Sections\School\Models\Murid;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Spatie\Permission\Models\Role;

class MuridService
{
    /** @param array<string,mixed> $data */
    public function tambah(int $sekolahId, array $data): Murid
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($sekolahId, $data): Murid {
            $user = User::query()->create([
                'name' => $data['nama'],
                'email' => mb_strtolower($data['email']),
                'password' => Hash::make($data['kata_sandi'] ?? Str::password(16)),
                'status' => UserStatus::Aktif->value,
                'role' => 'murid',
                'email_verified_at' => now(),
            ]);
            $user->assignRole(Role::findOrCreate('murid', 'web'));

            $murid = Murid::query()->create([
                'school_id' => $sekolahId,
                'class_id' => (int) $data['class_id'],
                'user_id' => $user->getKey(),
                'nis' => $data['nis'] ?? null,
                'nisn' => $data['nisn'] ?? null,
            ]);

            return $murid->load(['user', 'kelas']);
        });
    }

    /** @param array<string,mixed> $data */
    public function ubah(Murid $murid, array $data): Murid
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($murid, $data): Murid {
            $murid->user->forceFill(['name' => $data['nama']])->save();
            $murid->fill([
                'class_id' => (int) $data['class_id'],
                'nis' => $data['nis'] ?? null,
                'nisn' => $data['nisn'] ?? null,
            ])->save();

            return $murid->refresh()->load(['user', 'kelas']);
        });
    }

    public function hapus(Murid $murid): void
    {
        DB::transaction(function () use ($murid): void {
            $user = $murid->user;
            $murid->delete();
            $user->delete();
        });
    }
}
```
Careful: `$murid->user` lazy load — the model passed from route binding won't have user loaded → preventLazyLoading throws in tests! Need to load. In controller, route binding gives Murid without relations. Use `$murid->loadMissing('user')`? Still lazy loading. Better query directly: `User::query()->findOrFail($murid->user_id)`. Use that. Similarly ubah.

public function perbarui(SimpanPengaturanRequest $request, SekolahService $sekolahService, PengaturanService $service): JsonResponse

    $this->authorize('update', Pengaturan::class);
    $data = $request->validated();
    $lingkup = LingkupPengaturan::from($data['lingkup']);
    $kunci = KunciPengaturan::from($data['kunci']);
    $sekolahId = $sekolahService->tunggal()->id;
    $lingkupId = $lingkup === LingkupPengaturan::Sekolah ? $sekolahId : (int) $data['lingkup_id'];
    $nilai = $kunci->tipe() === 'integer' ? (int) $data['nilai'] : (bool) $data['nilai'];
    $service->simpan($lingkup, $lingkupId, $kunci, $nilai, (bool) ($data['terkunci'] ?? false));
    return response()->json($service->semua($sekolahId, $request->integer('kelas_id') ?: null, $request->integer('kuis_id') ?: null));
}

SimpanPengaturanRequest:
```php
namespace App\Sections\Settings\Http\Requests;

use App\Sections\School\Models\Kelas;
use App\Sections\Settings\Enums\KunciPengaturan;
use App\Sections\Settings\Enums\LingkupPengaturan;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
use Illuminate\Validation\Validator;

class SimpanPengaturanRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool { return $this->user() !== null; }

    public function rules(): array
    {
        return [
            'lingkup' => ['required', Rule::enum(LingkupPengaturan::class)],
            'lingkup_id' => ['nullable','integer','min:1'],
            'kunci' => ['required', Rule::enum(KunciPengaturan::class)],
            'nilai' => ['required'],
            'terkunci' => ['sometimes','boolean'],
            'kelas_id' => ['sometimes','nullable','integer'],  // konteks respons
            'kuis_id' => ['sometimes','nullable','integer'],
        ];
    }

    public function after(): array
    {
        return [function (Validator $validator): void {
            $lingkup = LingkupPengaturan::tryFrom((string) $this->input('lingkup'));
            $kunci = KunciPengaturan::tryFrom((string) $this->input('kunci'));

            if ($lingkup === null || $kunci === null) return;

            $nilai = $this->input('nilai');

            if ($kunci->tipe() === 'boolean' && ! is_bool($nilai)) {
                $validator->errors()->add('nilai', 'Nilai harus berupa benar/salah.');
            }
            if ($kunci->tipe() === 'integer' && ! (is_int($nilai) || (is_string($nilai) && ctype_digit($nilai)))) {
                $validator->errors()->add('nilai', 'Nilai harus berupa bilangan bulat.');
            }
            if ($kunci->tipe() === 'integer' && (int) $nilai < 0) {
                $validator->errors()->add('nilai', 'Nilai tidak boleh negatif.');
            }
            if ($lingkup !== LingkupPengaturan::Sekolah && ! $this->filled('lingkup_id')) {
                $validator->errors()->add('lingkup_id', 'Lingkup ID wajib untuk pengaturan kelas/kuis.');
            }
            if ($lingkup === LingkupPengaturan::Kelas && $this->filled('lingkup_id')
                && ! Kelas::query()->whereKey($this->integer('lingkup_id'))->exists()) {
                $validator->errors()->add('lingkup_id', 'Kelas tidak ditemukan.');
            }
        }];
    }
}
```
Note `'nilai' => ['required']` with false passes. But `filled('lingkup_id')` for integer; fine.

Mixing `$this->integer('lingkup_id')` — returns 0 if not int. Guarded by filled.

Resolution/lock test:
```php
it('urutan resolusi kuis > kelas > sekolah; lock sekolah mengalahkan semua', function () {
    Sanctum::actingAs($this->guru);

    // kelas override
    $this->putJson('/api/v1/pengaturan', ['lingkup'=>'kelas','lingkup_id'=>$this->kelas->id,'kunci'=>'retry','nilai'=>true])->assertOk();
    $res = $this->getJson('/api/v1/pengaturan?kelas_id='.$this->kelas->id)->assertOk();
    expect($res->json('pengaturan.retry.nilai'))->toBeTrue()
        ->and($res->json('pengaturan.retry.sumber'))->toBe('kelas');

    // kuis override kelas
    $this->putJson('/api/v1/pengaturan', ['lingkup'=>'kuis','lingkup_id'=>777,'kunci'=>'retry','nilai'=>false])->assertOk();
    $res = $this->getJson('/api/v1/pengaturan?kelas_id='.$this->kelas->id.'&kuis_id=777')->assertOk();
    expect($res->json('pengaturan.retry.sumber'))->toBe('kuis')
        ->and($res->json('pengaturan.retry.nilai'))->toBeFalse();

    // sekolah mengunci retry=true
    $this->putJson('/api/v1/pengaturan', ['lingkup'=>'sekolah','kunci'=>'retry','nilai'=>true,'terkunci'=>true])->assertOk();
    $res = $this->getJson('/api/v1/pengaturan?kelas_id='.$this->kelas->id.'&kuis_id=777')->assertOk();
    expect($res->json('pengaturan.retry.nilai'))->toBeTrue()
        ->and($res->json('pengaturan.retry.sumber'))->toBe('sekolah')
        ->and($res->json('pengaturan.retry.terkunci'))->toBeTrue();
});
```

/**
 * Halaman kelola kelas (slice 02) — CRUD untuk guru/admin.
 */
import { useState } from 'react'
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form'
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod'
import { skemaKelasForm } from './validasi.js'
import { ambilKelas, buatKelas, ubahKelas, hapusKelas } from './api.js'
import { pesanGalatApi, teksGalat } from '../auth/api.js'
import { tampilkanToast } from '../../shared/ui/toast.jsx'

const nilaiAwal = { nama: '', tingkat: '', tahun_ajaran: '' }

export default function HalamanKelas() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient()
  const [idUbah, setIdUbah] = useState(/** @type {number|null} */ (null))

  const kelas = useQuery({ queryKey: ['kelas'], queryFn: ambilKelas })

  const { register, handleSubmit, reset, formState: { errors, isSubmitting } } = useForm({
    resolver: zodResolver(skemaKelasForm),
    defaultValues: nilaiAwal,
  })

  const simpan = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (data) => {
      const muatan = {
        nama: data.nama,
        tingkat: Number(data.tingkat),
        tahun_ajaran: data.tahun_ajaran || undefined,
      }
      return idUbah === null ? buatKelas(muatan) : ubahKelas(idUbah, muatan)
    },
    onSuccess: async () => {
      tampilkanToast('sukses', idUbah === null ? 'Kelas ditambahkan.' : 'Kelas diperbarui.')
      setIdUbah(null)
      reset(nilaiAwal)
      await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['kelas'] })
    },
    onError: (galat) => tampilkanToast('salah', pesanGalatApi(galat)),
  })

  const hapus = useMutation({
    mutationFn: hapusKelas,
    onSuccess: async () => {
      tampilkanToast('info', 'Kelas dihapus.')
      await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['kelas'] })
    },
    onError: (galat) => tampilkanToast('salah', pesanGalatApi(galat)),
  })

  ...
}
```

  ...
}

        nilai: muatan.nilai,
        terkunci: kelasId ? false : muatan.terkunci,

  ...
}

```js
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import { skemaLaporanImpor, skemaResponsImpor } from './api.js'
import { ringkasLaporanImpor } from './validasi.js'

const laporanValid = { total:3, sukses:1, gagal:2, dihentikan:false, batas_galat:100, galat:[{baris:3,pesan:'Email tidak valid.'},{baris:4,pesan:'Kelas "9Z" tidak ditemukan.'}] }

describe('laporan impor', () => {
  it('memvalidasi bentuk laporan dari server', () => {
    const laporan = skemaLaporanImpor.parse(laporanValid)
    expect(laporan.galat).toHaveLength(2)
  })
  it('menolak laporan dengan tipe salah', () => {
    expect(() => skemaLaporanImpor.parse({...laporanValid, sukses:'satu'})).toThrow()
  })
  it('meringkas laporan menjadi pesan per baris', () => {
    const { ringkasan, galat } = ringkasLaporanImpor(skemaLaporanImpor.parse(laporanValid))
    expect(ringkasan).toContain('1 baris berhasil')
    expect(ringkasan).toContain('2 baris gagal')
    expect(galat.map(g=>g.baris)).toEqual([3,4])
    expect(galat[1].pesan).toContain('9Z')
  })
  it('menandai laporan yang dihentikan batas galat', () => {
    const { ringkasan } = ringkasLaporanImpor(skemaLaporanImpor.parse({...laporanValid, gagal:100, dihentikan:true}))
    expect(ringkasan).toContain('dihentikan setelah 100 galat')
  })
  it('memvalidasi respons impor lengkap', () => {
    const respons = skemaResponsImpor.parse({ message:'ok', laporan: laporanValid })
    expect(respons.laporan.total).toBe(3)
  })
})
```

validasi.test.js:

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import { skemaKelasForm, skemaMapelForm, skemaMuridForm } from './validasi.js'

describe('skemaKelasForm', () => {
  it('menerima kelas valid', () => {
    expect(skemaKelasForm.safeParse({ nama:'6A', tingkat:'6', tahun_ajaran:'2026/2027' }).success).toBe(true)
  })
  it('menolak tingkat di luar 1-6', () => {
    expect(skemaKelasForm.safeParse({ nama:'6A', tingkat:'7' }).success).toBe(false)
    expect(skemaKelasForm.safeParse({ nama:'6A', tingkat:'' }).success).toBe(false)
  })
  it('menolak nama kosong', () => {
    expect(skemaKelasForm.safeParse({ nama:'  ', tingkat:'1' }).success).toBe(false)
  })
})
describe('skemaMuridForm', () => {
  it('menerima murid valid', () => {
    const hasil = skemaMuridForm.safeParse({ nama:'Ayu Lestari', email:'ayu@murid.test', class_id:'1' })
    expect(hasil.success).toBe(true)
  })
  it('menolak email salah dan kelas kosong', () => {
    const hasil = skemaMuridForm.safeParse({ nama:'Ayu', email:'bukan-email', class_id:'' })
    expect(hasil.success).toBe(false)
    if (!hasil.success) {
      const jalur = hasil.error.issues.map((i)=>i.path[0])
      expect(jalur).toContain('email')
      expect(jalur).toContain('class_id')
    }
  })
})
describe('skemaMapelForm', () => {
  it('menolak kode dengan karakter aneh', () => {
    expect(skemaMapelForm.safeParse({ nama:'Matematika', kode:'MT K!' }).success).toBe(false)
  })
})
```

```python
import zipfile, html

def esc(s): return html.escape(s, quote=False)

def para(teks, bold=False, size=None):
    rpr = ''
    if bold: rpr = '<w:rPr><w:b/></w:rPr>'
    return f'<w:p><w:r>{rpr}<w:t xml:space="preserve">{esc(teks)}</w:t></w:r></w:p>'
```

Implementation:
```python
def tambah_teks(bagian, teks):
    if teks is None: return
    baris = str(teks).split("\n")
    potongan = 4000
    for i in range(0, len(baris), potongan):
        grup = baris[i:i+potongan]
        runs = "<w:br/>".join('<w:r><w:t xml:space="preserve">%s</w:t></w:r>' % bersih(b) for b in grup)
        bagian.append("<w:p>%s</w:p>" % runs)
```

Konten/kunci structures:

PilihanGanda:
- konten: {teks: string (required), opsi: [{id: 'A'|string, teks: string}] min 2, maximal 5? allow up to 6; matematika?: string (MathML), media?: string path}
- kunci: {jawaban: id}
Validation: jawaban must exist among opsi ids; ids unique.
nilai: jawaban === kunci['jawaban'] (normalize string cast).

BenarSalah:
- konten: {teks, pernyataan?: string}? Simplest: {teks: statement text, pembenaran? no}. kunci: {benar: bool}
Validation: kunci['benar'] must be bool.
nilai: (bool) jawaban === kunci['benar'].

Menjodohkan:
- konten: {teks, kiri:[{id,teks}] min 2, kanan:[{id,teks}] min 2}
- kunci: {pasangan: {kiriId: kananId}}
Validation: every kiri id has a mapping, mapping target exists in kanan, ids unique.
nilai: jawaban array pasangan; must match exactly (all pairs correct).

Mengurutkan:
- konten: {teks, item:[{id,teks}] min 2}
- kunci: {urutan:[ids]}
Validation: urutan is permutation of item ids.
nilai: jawaban (array ids) === kunci urutan.

For the FormRequest validation with registry, use `after()` hook:

```php
public function after(): array
{
    return [
        function (Validator $validator): void {
            if ($validator->errors()->isNotEmpty()) return; // hmm, should still validate structures? if base fields invalid, konten may be missing
            $tipe = TipeSoal::tryFrom((string) $this->input('tipe'));
            if ($tipe === null) return;
            $konten = $this->input('konten');
            $kunci = $this->input('kunci');
            if (!is_array($konten) || !is_array($kunci)) return;
            foreach (RegistryTipeSoal::validasi($tipe, $konten, $kunci) as $pesan) {
                $validator->errors()->add('konten', $pesan);
            }
        },
    ];
}
```
Careful: typed closure param must be `Illuminate\Validation\Validator` for after(). Signature: `after(): array` returning callables that receive `Validator`. In Laravel, `public function after(): array { return [function (\Illuminate\Validation\Validator $validator) {...}]; }`. Good.

Also `withValidator`? after() is supported in Laravel 10+. Fine.

Now implement the three auth changes.

### 1. Auto-login after register
Problem: pending accounts are rejected everywhere by `akun-aktif` middleware (alasanAkunDitolak returns "Verifikasi email dulu sebelum masuk." for Pending). So if we log them in, every protected endpoint returns 403 and the session is destroyed → the user would be bounced back to login. Not good.

Options:
(a) Auto-login AND allow unverified users to access a whitelist: `/auth/saya`, `/auth/kirim-ulang-verifikasi`, `/auth/keluar`. If `akun-aktif` logs them out, they can't even resend.
(b) Change `akun-aktif` to not reject Pending, but reject suspended/deleted; and gate unverified users at the app level (frontend shows "perlu verifikasi" page), with server-side protection: unverified users only get limited data? Risky — our security rule says unverified accounts rejected on all paths.

Hmm. The user wants UX: after registration → directly logged in. The intended UX: after register, user lands in app in "waiting verification" state (with the ability to resend email) rather than being kicked to login page with a message.

Best approach consistent with security: keep `alasanAkunDitolak` semantics but make the middleware allow unverified/pending accounts to reach only the verification-related routes. I.e., middleware returns 403 for suspended/deleted always; for pending (unverified) it returns 403 EXCEPT for a small whitelist (auth/saya, auth/kirim-ulang-verifikasi, auth/keluar).

Implement: in EnsureAccountUsable, add a check: if the reason is the verification one and the route name is in whitelist → allow. But then the user can reach `/auth/saya` → the frontend can render the "perlu verifikasi" screen (HalamanPerluVerifikasi exists!). That gives good UX: registered → logged in → app shows "verifikasi email dulu" with resend button.

### 2. SMTP fail-open ("lebih optimistis")
Wrap `sendEmailVerificationNotification()` and password reset link sending in try/catch, log a warning, and report `email_terkirim: false` in the response so UI can say "email gagal terkirim, coba lagi nanti" while still succeeding.

Implementation: a small helper service `App\Sections\Auth\Services\PengirimEmail` (mailer wrapper):
```php
class PengirimEmail {
  public function coba(callable $aksi): bool {
     try { $aksi(); return true; } catch (Throwable $e) { Log::warning('Pengiriman email gagal (fail-open): '.$e->getMessage()); return false; }
  }
}
```

/**
 * Registry tipe soal sisi klien (cermin App\Sections\Question\Enums\TipeSoal
 * dan RegistryTipeSoal di backend). Empat tipe objektif sudah bisa disimpan;
 * empat tipe esai ditampilkan sebagai pilihan belum tersedia.
 */

/** Nilai tipe soal — harus sama persis dengan enum backend. */
export const TIPE = {
  pilihanGanda: 'pilihan_ganda',
  benarSalah: 'benar_salah',
  isianSingkat: 'isian_singkat',
  uraian: 'uraian',
  menjodohkan: 'menjodohkan',
  mengurutkan: 'mengurutkan',
  letakKata: 'letak_kata',
  hubungKata: 'hubung_kata',
}

/** @type {Record<string, string>} */
export const LABEL_TIPE = {
  [TIPE.pilihanGanda]: 'Pilihan ganda',
  [TIPE.benarSalah]: 'Benar / salah',
  [TIPE.isianSingkat]: 'Isian singkat',
  [TIPE.uraian]: 'Uraian',
  [TIPE.menjodohkan]: 'Menjodohkan',
  [TIPE.mengurutkan]: 'Mengurutkan',
  [TIPE.letakKata]: 'Letak kata',
  [TIPE.hubungKata]: 'Hubung kata',
}

/** Tipe objektif (didukung registry backend). */
export const TIPE_OBJEKTIF = [TIPE.pilihanGanda, TIPE.benarSalah, TIPE.menjodohkan, TIPE.mengurutkan]

/** Opsi <select> editor: tipe esai ikut tampil tapi ditandai belum tersedia. */
export const DAFTAR_TIPE = Object.keys(LABEL_TIPE).map((nilai) => ({
  nilai,
  label: LABEL_TIPE[nilai],
  objektif: TIPE_OBJEKTIF.includes(nilai),
}))

/** Batas opsi pilihan ganda (cermin PenanganPilihanGanda). */
export const MIN_OPSI = 2
export const MAKS_OPSI = 6
/** Minimal pasangan menjodohkan / item mengurutkan. */
export const MIN_ITEM = 2

/** @param {unknown} nilai @returns {string} */
export function teksAman(nilai) {
  return typeof nilai === 'string' ? nilai : ''
}

/**
 * Daftar item {id, teks} dari konten server (tahan data kotor).
 * @param {unknown} nilai
 * @returns {{ id: string, teks: string }[]}
 */
export function daftarAman(nilai) {
  if (!Array.isArray(nilai)) return []
  return nilai
    .filter((baris) => baris !== null && typeof baris === 'object')
    .map((baris) => ({ id: teksAman(/** @type {any} */ (baris).id), teks: teksAman(/** @type {any} */ (baris).teks) }))
}
```
Hmm `/** @type {any} */` — better `typeof baris === 'object'` narrowing then cast to `Record<string, unknown>`:
```js
const rekaman = /** @type {Record<string, unknown>} */ (baris)
```
That's cleaner.

```js
/**
 * Id berikutnya yang belum dipakai (mis. 'A', 'B', …).
 * @param {string} prefix
 * @param {{ id: string }[]} daftar
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function idBerikut(prefix, daftar) {
  const dipakai = new Set(daftar.map((satu) => satu.id))
  let nomor = 1
  while (dipakai.has(`${prefix}${nomor}`)) nomor += 1
  return `${prefix}${nomor}`
}
```

  ...
  return galat
}

const TAGS = new Set([...])

/**
 * Ubah untai MathML menjadi elemen React tanpa dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
 * @param {string} teks
 * @returns {import('react').ReactNode|null}
 */
export function mathmlKeElemen(teks) {
  if (typeof DOMParser === 'undefined') return null
  const dokumen = new DOMParser().parseFromString(teks, 'text/html')
  const akar = dokumen.querySelector('math')
  if (akar === null) return null
  return elemenDariSimpul(akar, 'm0')

Implementation:
```js
/** @param {Node} simpul @returns {import('react').ReactNode} */
function elemenDariSimpul(simpul) {
  if (simpul.nodeType === 3) return simpul.textContent
  if (simpul.nodeType !== 1) return null
  const elemen = /** @type {Element} */ (simpul)
  const nama = elemen.tagName.toLowerCase()
  if (!TAGS_DIIZINKAN.has(nama)) return elemen.textContent
  const props = {}
  for (const atribut of Array.from(elemen.attributes)) {
    if (ATRIBUT_DIIZINKAN.has(atribut.name)) props[atribut.name] = atribut.value
  }
  const anak = []
  let nomor = 0
  for (const isi of Array.from(elemen.childNodes)) {
    anak.push(<span key={nomor}>{elemenDariSimpul(isi)}</span>)
    nomor += 1
  }
```
Hmm wrapping in span for text breaks MathML semantics (text nodes inside <mn> must be raw). Instead:
```js
  const anak = Array.from(elemen.childNodes).map((isi, nomor) => (
    <Fragment key={nomor}>{elemenDariSimpul(isi)}</Fragment>
  ))
```
Using `Fragment` from react. Good — that preserves text nodes properly.

Then `createElement(nama, {...props, key}, ...anak)`? Since we're inside a React component returning ReactNode, we can use `createElement`. Use `import { Fragment, createElement } from 'react'`.

props keys: attribute names are lowercase (MathML attrs are lowercase) so no className conversion needed. Fine — for `class` attribute on math we'd need className; skip 'class' from allowlist. It's fine to pass as-is (React allows unknown attrs lowercase). Include 'xmlns'? XMLNS in createElement props is allowed as `xmlns`. Skip it to avoid warnings.

import { daftarAman, teksAman } from '../tipeSoal.js'
import MediaSoal from './MediaSoal.jsx'

export default function SoalPilihanGanda({ konten, kunci = {}, nilai, onUbah, dinonaktifkan = false, tampilkanKunci = false, nama = 'soal' }) {
  const opsi = daftarAman(konten.opsi)
  const kunciJawaban = teksAman(kunci.jawaban)
  return (
    <div className="soal-render">
      <p className="soal-teks">{teksAman(konten.teks)}</p>
      <MediaSoal konten={konten} />
      <ul className="daftar-opsi list-unstyled mb-0">
        {opsi.map((satu) => {
          const benar = tampilkanKunci && satu.id === kunciJawaban
          return (
            <li key={satu.id} className="form-check d-flex gap-2 align-items-start">
              <input
                className="form-check-input mt-1"
                type="radio"
                name={nama}
                id={`${nama}-${satu.id}`}
                value={satu.id}
                checked={nilai === satu.id}
                disabled={dinonaktifkan}
                onChange={() => onUbah?.(satu.id)}
              />
              <label className={`form-check-label ${benar ? 'fw-semibold' : ''}`} htmlFor={`${nama}-${satu.id}`}>
                <span className="opsi-huruf">{satu.id}.</span> {satu.teks}
                {benar && <span className="badge-kunci ms-2">kunci</span>}
              </label>
            </li>
          )
        })}
      </ul>
    </div>
  )
}
```

Careful typing in mathml walker with strict checkJs.

```jsx
import { Fragment, createElement } from 'react'
import { teksAman } from '../tipeSoal.js'

/** Elemen MathML yang boleh dirender (daftar putih). */
const TAGS_MATHML = new Set([
  'math','mrow','mi','mn','mo','mtext','ms','mspace','msup','msub','msubsup','mfrac','msqrt','mroot',
  'mfenced','mtable','mtr','mtd','munder','mover','munderover','mmultiscripts','mprescripts','none',
  'mstyle','mpadded','mphantom','menclose','semantics','annotation','annotation-xml','mlabeledtr',
])

/** Atribut MathML yang diteruskan apa adanya ke elemen React. */
const ATRIBUT_MATHML = new Set([
  'display','mathvariant','mathsize','mathcolor','mathbackground','stretchy','fence','separator',
  'linethickness','notation','columnalign','rowalign','columnspacing','rowspacing','columnlines',
  'rowlines','width','height','depth','scriptlevel','movablelimits','accent','accentunder','form',
  'lspace','rspace','open','close','separators','minsize','maxsize','largeop','symmetric',
])

/**
 * Ubah simpul DOM hasil parse menjadi elemen React (tanpa innerHTML).
 * @param {Node} simpul
 * @returns {import('react').ReactNode}
 */
function elemenDariSimpul(simpul) {
  if (simpul.nodeType === 3) return simpul.textContent
  if (simpul.nodeType !== 1) return null

  const elemen = /** @type {Element} */ (simpul)
  const nama = elemen.tagName.toLowerCase()

  if (!TAGS_MATHML.has(nama)) return elemen.textContent

  /** @type {Record<string, string>} */
  const sifat = {}
  for (const atribut of Array.from(elemen.attributes)) {
    if (ATRIBUT_MATHML.has(atribut.name)) sifat[atribut.name] = atribut.value
  }

  const anak = Array.from(elemen.childNodes).map((isi, nomor) => (
    <Fragment key={nomor}>{elemenDariSimpul(isi)}</Fragment>
  ))

  return createElement(nama, { ...sifat, key: nama }, ...anak)
}
```
Hmm `key: nama` weird — key only matters in arrays; we wrap in Fragment with key already. Remove key.

`createElement(nama, sifat, ...anak)` — typing: `createElement` accepts `(type: string, props: any, ...children)`. With TS + React 19 types, `createElement(type: FunctionComponent | string, ...)`. Since children are ReactNode, fine.

`Array.from(elemen.attributes)` → `Attr[]`; `atribut.name` ok.

`elemen.childNodes` → NodeListOf<ChildNode>; `Array.from(...)` ok.

Then:
```jsx
/**
 * MathML dari guru → elemen native. Bila DOMParser tidak ada (lingkungan uji
 * tanpa DOM), tampilkan teksnya saja supaya tidak ada markup mentah.
 * @param {string} teks
 * @returns {import('react').ReactNode|null}
 */
export function mathmlKeElemen(teks) {
  if (typeof DOMParser === 'undefined') return null

  const dokumen = new DOMParser().parseFromString(teks, 'text/html')
  const akar = dokumen.querySelector('math')
  if (akar === null) return null

  return elemenDariSimpul(akar)
}

/** Bersihkan tanda kurung sudut saat MathML tidak bisa dirender. */
export function teksTanpaTag(teks) {
  return teks.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()
}

/** @param {{ konten: Record<string, unknown> }} props */
export default function MediaSoal({ konten }) {
  const media = teksAman(konten.media)
  const matematika = teksAman(konten.matematika).trim()
  const elemen = matematika === '' ? null : mathmlKeElemen(matematika)

  return (
    <>
      {media !== '' && (
        <img className="media-soal" src={media} alt="Media pendukung soal" loading="lazy" />
      )}
      {elemen !== null && <div className="mathml-soal">{elemen}</div>}
      {matematika !== '' && elemen === null && (
        <p className="mathml-soal teks-lembut small mb-0">{teksTanpaTag(matematika)}</p>
      )}
    </>
  )
}
```

Wait: `dokumen.querySelector('math')` returns Element|null typed as Element. `elemenDariSimpul(akar)` accepts Node. fine.

One risk: parsing `<math>...</math>` via text/html — DOMParser will place it in body. querySelector('math') works.

PilihanGanda:
```jsx
/**
 * Renderer pilihan ganda (2–6 opsi).
 * konten: { teks, opsi:[{id,teks}] } · kunci: { jawaban: id }
 */
import MediaSoal from './MediaSoal.jsx'
import { daftarAman, teksAman } from '../tipeSoal.js'

/** @param {import('./props.js').PropsSoal} props */
export default function SoalPilihanGanda({
  konten,
  kunci = {},
  nilai,
  onUbah,
  dinonaktifkan = false,
  tampilkanKunci = false,
  nama = 'soal',
}) {
  const opsi = daftarAman(konten.opsi)
  const kunciJawaban = teksAman(kunci.jawaban)

  return (
    <div className="soal-render">
      <p className="soal-teks">{teksAman(konten.teks)}</p>
      <MediaSoal konten={konten} />
      <ul className="soal-opsi list-unstyled mb-0">
        {opsi.map((satu) => {
          const iniKunci = tampilkanKunci && satu.id === kunciJawaban
          const idInput = `${nama}-${satu.id}`
          return (
            <li key={satu.id} className="form-check d-flex gap-2 align-items-start">
              <input
                className="form-check-input mt-1"
                type="radio"
                name={nama}
                id={idInput}
                value={satu.id}
                checked={nilai === satu.id}
                disabled={dinonaktifkan}
                onChange={() => onUbah?.(satu.id)}
              />
              <label className="form-check-label" htmlFor={idInput}>
                <span className="opsi-huruf">{satu.id}.</span> {satu.teks}
                {iniKunci && <span className="badge-kunci ms-2">Kunci</span>}
              </label>
            </li>
          )
        })}
      </ul>
    </div>
  )
}
```

export default function SoalMengurutkan({ konten, kunci = {}, nilai, onUbah, dinonaktifkan = false, tampilkanKunci = false, nama = 'soal' }) {
  const item = daftarAman(konten.item)
  const jawaban = rekamanTeks(nilai)
  const kunciUrutan = daftarTeks(kunci.urutan)
  return (
    <ul className="soal-urut list-unstyled mb-0">
      {item.map((satu) => {
        const posisi = jawaban[satu.id] ?? ''
        const posisiKunci = kunciUrutan.indexOf(satu.id) + 1
        const benar = tampilkanKunci && Number(posisi) === posisiKunci
        return (
          <li key={satu.id} className="d-flex align-items-center gap-2 mb-2">
            <input
              className="form-control form-control-sm urut-posisi"
              type="number"
              min={1}
              max={item.length}
              inputMode="numeric"
              aria-label={`Nomor urut untuk ${satu.teks}`}
              value={posisi}
              disabled={dinonaktifkan}
              onChange={(e) => onUbah?.({ ...jawaban, [satu.id]: e.target.value })}
            />
            <span>{satu.teks}</span>
            {tampilkanKunci && <span className="badge-kunci">{benar ? 'tepat' : `kunci: ${posisiKunci}`}</span>}
          </li>
        )
      })}
    </ul>
  )
}

State: `const [state, setState] = useState(() => soal ? stateDariSoal(soal) : stateSoalKosong())`.
Effect: when `soal` changes (id changes) → reset state. Use `useEffect(() => { setState(soal ? stateDariSoal(soal) : stateSoalKosong()) }, [soal])`. Since `soal` object identity may change on each render of parent (list data), the effect could loop resetting edits. Parent passes `soal` from query data (stable per query result) or null. ```js
/**
 * Label status kuis untuk murid (waktu relatif terhadap jadwal).
 * @param {{status: string, sedang_berjalan: boolean, mulai_at: string|null, selesai_at: string|null}} kuis
 * @returns {{ label: string, jenis: 'sukses'|'info'|'peringatan'|'lembut' }}
 */
export function statusTampilan(kuis) {
  if (kuis.status !== 'publikasi') return { label: kuis.status === 'arsip' ? 'Diarsipkan' : 'Draf', jenis: 'lembut' }
  if (kuis.sedang_berjalan) return { label: 'Sedang berjalan', jenis: 'sukses' }
  if (kuis.mulai_at !== null && new Date(kuis.mulai_at).getTime() > Date.now()) return { label: 'Belum dimulai', jenis: 'info' }
  return { label: 'Selesai', jenis: 'peringatan' }
}
```

}

For textarea, constructor.prototype is HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype — the generic approach works. For select: set value + dispatch 'change'. For checkbox/radio: click().

Simpler: define a page-side utility once via Runtime.evaluate:

```js
await evalJs(`window.__alat = {
  isi(sel, nilai) {
    const el = document.querySelector(sel)
    if (!el) throw new Error('elemen tidak ada: ' + sel)
    const proto = el instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement ? HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype : el instanceof HTMLSelectElement ? HTMLSelectElement.prototype : HTMLInputElement.prototype
    Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(proto, 'value').set.call(el, nilai)
    el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }))
    el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }))
    return true
  },
  klik(sel) { const el = document.querySelector(sel); if (!el) throw new Error('tidak ada: ' + sel); el.click(); return true },
  teks(sel) { return document.querySelector(sel)?.innerText ?? '' },
}`)
```
Note: for React controlled inputs, dispatching 'input' after native setter works.

**PenilaianObjektif** (Scoring/Services/PenilaianObjektif.php):
```php
final class PenilaianObjektif
{
    /** @return array{status: StatusPenilaian, benar: bool|null, skor: float} */
    public function nilai(Soal $soal, mixed $jawaban): array
    {
        $tipe = $soal->tipeAman();
        if ($tipe === null) return ['status' => Gagal, 'benar' => null, 'skor' => 0.0];
        if (! $tipe->objektif()) return ['status' => PerluTinjau, 'benar' => null, 'skor' => 0.0];
        if ($jawaban === null) return ['status' => Dinilai, 'benar' => false, 'skor' => 0.0];
        try {
            $benar = RegistryTipeSoal::nilai($tipe, $soal->kontenSebagaiArray(), $soal->kunciSebagaiArray(), $jawaban);
        } catch (Throwable) {
            return ['status' => Gagal, 'benar' => null, 'skor' => 0.0];
        }
        return ['status' => Dinilai, 'benar' => $benar, 'skor' => $benar ? (float) $soal->skor : 0.0];
    }
}
```

final class Pengacakan
{
    public static function urutSoal(array $soal, int $seed, int $attemptId): array
    {
        return self::urutBy(fn (Soal $s): string => sha1($seed.'|attempt-'.$attemptId.'|soal|'.$s->getKey()), $soal);
    }

    public static function urutOpsi(array $opsi, int $seed, int|string $soalId, bool $acak): array

        if (! $acak) return array_values($opsi);
        return self::urutBy(fn (array $o): string => sha1($seed.'|soal-'.$soalId.'|opsi|'.($o['id'] ?? '')), $opsi);
    }

    private static function urutBy(callable $bobot, array $daftar): array  // usort
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Sections\Attempt\Services;

use App\Models\User;
use App\Sections\Attempt\Enums\JenisAttempt;
use App\Sections\Attempt\Enums\StatusAttempt;
use App\Sections\Attempt\Models\Attempt;
use App\Sections\Attempt\Models\Jawaban;
use App\Sections\Question\Models\Soal;
use App\Sections\Quiz\Models\Kuis;
use App\Sections\Scoring\Enums\StatusPenilaian;
use App\Sections\Scoring\Services\PenilaianObjektif;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class AttemptService
{
    /** Toleransi keterlambatan mengumpulkan (detik) — server yang menentukan. */
    public const TENGGAT_TERLAMBAT = 120;

    public function __construct(private readonly PenilaianObjektif $penilaian) {}

    public function mulai(Kuis $kuis, User $murid, JenisAttempt $jenis = JenisAttempt::Ulangan): Attempt
    {
        $profil = $murid->murid;
        if ($profil === null) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['kuis' => 'Hanya akun murid yang bisa mengerjakan kuis.']);
        }
        if ($kuis->status !== StatusKuis::Publikasi) throw ValidationException::withMessages(['kuis' => 'Kuis belum diterbitkan.']);
        // kelas & sekolah
        if ((int) $profil->class_id !== (int) $kuis->class_id) throw ValidationException::withMessages(['kuis' => 'Kuis ini bukan untuk kelasmu.']);

        $sekarang = Carbon::now();
        if ($kuis->mulai_at !== null && $kuis->mulai_at->greaterThan($sekarang)) throw ...'Kuis belum dimulai.'
        if ($kuis->selesai_at !== null && $kuis->selesai_at->lessThan($sekarang)) throw ...'Waktu kuis sudah berakhir.'

        $aktif = Attempt::query()
            ->where('quiz_id', $kuis->id)->where('student_id', $profil->id)
            ->where('jenis', $jenis->value)->where('aktif', true)->first();

        if ($aktif !== null) {
            return $this->muat($aktif);
        }

        $jumlahSoal = $kuis->soal()->count();

        $attempt = Attempt::query()->create([
            'school_id' => $kuis->school_id,
            'quiz_id' => $kuis->id,
            'student_id' => $profil->id,
            'jenis' => $jenis,
            'status' => StatusAttempt::Berjalan,
            'aktif' => true,
            'seed' => random_int(1, 2_147_483_647),
            'mulai_at' => $sekarang,
            'deadline_at' => $sekarang->copy()->addMinutes($kuis->durasi_menit),
            'jumlah_soal' => $jumlahSoal,
            'skor_maksimal' => (float) $kuis->soal()->sum('skor'),
        ]);

        return $this->muat($attempt);
    }
```
Note `$kuis->soal()` is a BelongsToMany → `->count()`, `->sum('skor')` work.

`kumpulkan(Attempt $attempt, string $idempotencyKey): Attempt`:
```php
$attempt->refresh(); // fresh state
return DB::transaction(function () use ($attempt, $idempotencyKey): Attempt {
    $baru = Attempt::query()->whereKey($attempt->getKey())->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();
    if (! $baru->berjalan()) {
        return $this->muat($baru);   // idempoten: dobel klik / dua tab
    }
    $sekarang = Carbon::now();
    $terlambat = $sekarang->greaterThan($baru->deadline_at);
    if ($terlambat && $sekarang->greaterThan($baru->deadline_at->copy()->addSeconds(self::TENGGAT_TERLAMBAT))) {
        throw ValidationException::withMessages(['attempt' => 'Waktu ulangan sudah habis; jawaban tidak bisa dikumpulkan lagi.']);
    }
    $soal = $this->soalUntuk($baru);  // loads kuis.soal
    $total = 0.0; $benar = 0;
    foreach ($soal as $satu) {
        $hasil = $this->nilaiSatuSoal($baru, $satu, $sekarang);
        $total += $hasil['skor'];
        if ($hasil['benar'] === true) $benar++;
    }
    $baru->forceFill([
        'status' => StatusAttempt::Selesai,
        'aktif' => null,
        'dikumpulkan_at' => $sekarang,
        'terlambat' => $terlambat,
        'skor' => $total,
        'jumlah_benar' => $benar,
        'idempotency_key' => mb_substr($idempotencyKey, 0, 64),
    ])->save();
    return $this->muat($baru->refresh());
});
```
`nilaiSatuSoal(Attempt, Soal, Carbon): array` — writes Jawaban row:
```php
private function nilaiSatuSoal(Attempt $attempt, Soal $soal, Carbon $sekarang): array
{
    $jawaban = Jawaban::query()->where('attempt_id', $attempt->id)->where('question_id', $soal->id)->first();

    try {
        $hasil = $this->penilaian->nilai($soal, $jawaban?->jawaban);
    } catch (Throwable) {
        $hasil = ['status' => StatusPenilaian::Gagal, 'benar' => null, 'skor' => 0.0];
    }

    // Jawaban kosong tetap dicatat supaya guru tahu soal mana yang tidak diisi.
    $baris = $jawaban ?? new Jawaban(['attempt_id' => $attempt->id, 'question_id' => $soal->id, 'jawaban' => null]);
    $baris->forceFill([
        'status' => $hasil['status'],
        'benar' => $hasil['benar'],
        'skor' => $hasil['skor'],
        'dinilai_at' => $sekarang,
    ])->save();

    return $hasil;
}
```

AttemptPolicy:
```php
class AttemptPolicy
{
    public function viewAny(User $user): bool { return true; }

    public function view(User $user, Attempt $attempt): bool
    {
        if ($user->isGuru()) return true;
        return $this->milikMurid($user, $attempt);
    }

    public function create(User $user): bool { return $user->isMurid(); }

    public function jawab(User $user, Attempt $attempt): bool
    {
        return $this->milikMurid($user, $attempt) && $attempt->berjalan();
    }

    public function kumpulkan(User $user, Attempt $attempt): bool
    {
        return $this->milikMurid($user, $attempt) && $attempt->berjalan();
    }

    public function hasil(User $user, Attempt $attempt): bool
    {
        return $this->view($user, $attempt);
    }

    public function delete(User $user, Attempt $attempt): bool { return $user->isGuru(); }

    private function milikMurid(User $user, Attempt $attempt): bool
    {
        $profil = $user->murid;
        return $profil !== null && (int) $profil->getKey() === (int) $attempt->student_id;
    }
}
```
`$user->isGuru()`/`isMurid()` exist (used in KuisPolicy).

use App\Sections\Question\Models\Soal;
