use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Laravel\Sanctum\Sanctum;

uses(RefreshDatabase::class);

beforeEach(function (): void {
    $this->seed(RolesAndAdminSeeder::class);
    $this->seed(SekolahSeeder::class);
    $this->sekolah = Sekolah::query()->firstOrFail();
    $this->kelas = Kelas::factory()->untukSekolah($this->sekolah)->create(['nama' => '5A', 'tingkat' => 5]);
    $this->mapel = Mapel::factory()->untukSekolah($this->sekolah)->create(['nama' => 'Matematika', 'kode' => 'MTK']);
    $this->guru = User::factory()->guru()->create();
    $this->murid = Murid::factory()->create(['school_id' => $this->sekolah->id, 'class_id' => $this->kelas->id]);
});

/** Kuis terbit berjalan + soal PG dan benar/salah (skor 5 masing-masing). */
function siapkanKuis(object $ctx, array $tambahan = []): Kuis
{
    $kuis = Kuis::factory()->untukSekolah($ctx->sekolah, $ctx->mapel, $ctx->kelas)->berjalan()->create([
        'acak_soal' => false,
        'acak_opsi' => false,
        ...$tambahan,
    ]);

    $pg = Soal::factory()->untukSekolah($ctx->sekolah, $ctx->mapel)->create(['skor' => 5]);
    $bs = Soal::factory()->benarSalah()->untukSekolah($ctx->sekolah, $ctx->mapel)->create(['skor' => 5]);

    $kuis->soal()->attach([$pg->id => ['urutan' => 1], $bs->id => ['urutan' => 2]]);

    return $kuis->refresh();
}
```
Careful: `$kuis->refresh()` then `$kuis->soal` lazy... fine.

Hmm `->create()` with `'acak_soal' => false` — KuisFactory state can be overridden by create attributes. Yes.

```js
/** Cadangan jawaban lokal (tanpa kunci) — dipulihkan saat jaringan/rel ulang. */
export const useSimpananJawaban = create(persist((set, get) => ({
  perAttempt: {},   // { [attemptId]: { jawaban: { [questionId]: nilai }, belumTerkirim: { [questionId]: nilai }, idempotencyKey, disimpanAt } }
  catat(attemptId, questionId, nilai) {...},
  tandaiTerkirim(attemptId, questionId) {...},
  ambil(attemptId) {...},
  kunciIdempotensi(attemptId) {...},  // generate once & keep
  bersihkan(attemptId) {...},
}), { name: 'ulangan-jawaban-v1' }))
```
Design details: `catat` stores into `jawaban` and also into `belumTerkirim`. `tandaiTerkirim` removes from `belumTerkirim`. `ambil(attemptId)` returns `{jawaban, belumTerkirim, idempotencyKey}`. Must not store kunci (nothing to store) — add a comment.

hitungMundur.js:
```js
/**
 * Sisa detik yang dikoreksi ke jam server.
 * @param {{ deadlineIso: string, serverNowIso: string, sekarangMs: number }} arg
 */
export function sisaDetikServer({ deadlineIso, serverNowIso, sekarangMs }) {
  const deadline = Date.parse(deadlineIso)
  const serverNow = Date.parse(serverNowIso)
  if (!Number.isFinite(deadline) || !Number.isFinite(serverNow)) return 0
  const geser = serverNow - sekarangMs       // jam server - jam klien (ms)
  return Math.max(0, Math.round((deadline - (sekarangMs + geser)) / 1000))
}
/** @param {number} detik */
export function formatSisa(detik) { ... 'MM:SS' or 'H:MM:SS' }
```

  ```js
  const antrean = useRef(new Map())   // questionId → nilai
  const timer = useRef(null)
  function jadwalkanKirim() {
    if (timer.current) return
    timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => void kirimAntrean(), 800)
  }
  async function kirimAntrean() {
    timer.current = null
    const entri = [...antrean.current.entries()]
    antrean.current.clear()
    for (const [questionId, nilai] of entri) {
      try { await kirimJawaban(attempt.id, questionId, nilai); simpanan.tandaiTerkirim(attempt.id, questionId) }
      catch (galat) {
        if (!galat?.response || galat.response.status >= 500 || galat.response.status === 408 || galat.response.status === 429) {
          antrean.current.set(questionId, nilai)   // ulangi nanti
        } else {
          tampilkanToast('salah', pesanGalatApi(galat))  // 4xx lain: buang (mis. sudah lewat deadline)
        }
      }
    }
    if (antrean.current.size > 0) window.setTimeout(() => void kirimAntrean(), 5000)
  }
  ```

BatasGalatUlangan:
```jsx
import { ErrorBoundary } from 'react-error-boundary'
import Banner from '../../shared/ui/Banner.jsx'
import { Tombol } from '../../shared/ui/Tombol.jsx'

/**
 * Pagar error khusus ulangan: fail-open — jangan biarkan satu error render
 * membuat murid kehilangan sesi pengerjaan; jawaban tetap ada di cadangan lokal.
 * @param {{ children: import('react').ReactNode }} props
 */
export default function BatasGalatUlangan({ children }) {
  return (
    <ErrorBoundary
      fallbackRender={({ error, resetErrorBoundary }) => (
        <div className="kartu-soft p-4">
          <Banner jenis="salah" judul="Layar ulangan tersendat">
            <p className="mb-2">Jawaban yang sudah kamu isi tetap tersimpan di perangkat ini. Coba tampilkan lagi layar ulangan.</p>
            <p className="teks-lembut small mb-3">Catatan teknis: {error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'galat tidak dikenal'}</p>
            <Tombol onClick={resetErrorBoundary}>Coba tampilkan lagi</Tombol>
          </Banner>
        </div>
      )}
    >
      {children}
    </ErrorBoundary>
  )
}
```
react-error-boundary v6 API: `ErrorBoundary` with `fallbackRender`. Also needs `onError` optional. Type of `error` in fallbackRender: `Error`. In v6, fallbackRender receives `{error, resetErrorBoundary}`. Type check may complain about `error.message` if error typed as Error — fine.

Hmm: does `react-error-boundary` v6 keep `fallbackRender`? v5/v6 support `fallbackRender` and `FallbackComponent`. Yes.

    queryKey: ['attempt-mulai', idKuis],
    queryFn: () => mulaiKuis(idKuis),
    enabled: Number.isInteger(idKuis) && idKuis > 0,
    retry: 1,
  })

  const attempt = mulainya.data

  const ambilCadangan = useSimpananJawaban((s) => s.ambil)
  const kunciIdempotensi = useSimpananJawaban((s) => s.kunciIdempotensi)

Flush logic:
```jsx
async function kirimAntrean(idAttempt) {
  const entri = [...antrean.current.entries()]
  antrean.current.clear()
  for (const [questionId, nilai] of entri) {
    try {
      await kirimJawaban(idAttempt, Number(questionId), nilai)
      tandaiTerkirim(idAttempt, Number(questionId))
    } catch (galat) {
      const status = /** @type {number|undefined} */ (galat?.response?.status)
      if (status === undefined || status === 408 || status === 429 || status >= 500) {
        antrean.current.set(questionId, nilai)
      } else {
        tampilkanToast('salah', pesanGalatApi(galat))
      }
    }
  }
}
```

In status.js append:

```js
/**
 * ISO dari server → nilai <input type="datetime-local"> dalam waktu lokal.
 * @param {string|null} iso
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function keLokal(iso) {
  if (iso === null) return ''

  const waktu = new Date(iso)
  const duaDigit = (angka) => String(angka).padStart(2, '0')

  return (
    [waktu.getFullYear(), duaDigit(waktu.getMonth() + 1), duaDigit(waktu.getDate())].join('-') +
    `T${duaDigit(waktu.getHours())}:${duaDigit(waktu.getMinutes())}`
  )
}

/**
 * Nilai <input type="datetime-local"> (waktu lokal) → ISO UTC untuk server.
 * Tanpa konversi ini, jadwal yang diisi guru akan bergeser sebesar offset zona
 * waktu karena server menyimpan dalam UTC.
 * @param {string} lokal
 * @returns {string|null}
 */
export function keIso(lokal) {
  if (lokal === '') return null

  const waktu = new Date(lokal)
  return Number.isNaN(waktu.getTime()) ? null : waktu.toISOString()
}
```

```php
<?php declare(strict_types=1);
namespace App\Sections\Report\Services;

use App\Sections\Attempt\Enums\JenisAttempt;
use App\Sections\Attempt\Models\Attempt;
use App\Sections\Quiz\Models\Kuis;
use App\Sections\Settings\Enums\KunciPengaturan;
use App\Sections\Settings\Services\PengaturanService;

class RankingService
{
    public const BAWAAN_TOP = 10;
    public const TOP_MAKSIMAL = 50;

    public function __construct(private readonly PengaturanService $pengaturan) {}

    public function tampil(Kuis $kuis): bool
    {
        $peta = $this->pengaturan->semua((int)$kuis->school_id, (int)$kuis->class_id, (int)$kuis->getKey())['pengaturan'];
        return (bool) ($peta[KunciPengaturan::Ranking->value]['nilai'] ?? KunciPengaturan::Ranking->bawaan());
    }

    /** seluruh peringkat (tanpa dipotong) */
    public function semua(Kuis $kuis): array
    {
        $baris = Attempt::query()
            ->join('students', 'students.id', '=', 'attempts.student_id')
            ->join('users', 'users.id', '=', 'students.user_id')
            ->where('attempts.quiz_id', $kuis->getKey())
            ->where('attempts.jenis', JenisAttempt::Ulangan->value)
            ->where('attempts.asli', true)
            ->whereNotNull('attempts.dikumpulkan_at')
            ->orderByDesc('attempts.skor')
            ->orderBy('attempts.dikumpulkan_at')
            ->orderBy('users.name')
            ->get([
                'attempts.id as attempt_id',
                'attempts.skor',
                'attempts.skor_maksimal',
                'attempts.jumlah_benar',
                'attempts.jumlah_soal',
                'attempts.dikumpulkan_at',
                'students.id as murid_id',
                'users.name as nama',
            ]);

        $hasil = [];
        foreach ($baris as $i => $satu) {
            $maks = (float) $satu->skor_maksimal;
            $hasil[] = [
                'peringkat' => $i + 1,
                'attempt_id' => (int) $satu->attempt_id,
                'murid_id' => (int) $satu->murid_id,
                'nama' => (string) $satu->nama,
                'skor' => (float) $satu->skor,
                'skor_maksimal' => $maks,
                'persen' => $maks > 0 ? round((float)$satu->skor / $maks * 100, 1) : 0.0,
                'jumlah_benar' => (int) $satu->jumlah_benar,
                'jumlah_soal' => (int) $satu->jumlah_soal,
                'dikumpulkan_at' => $satu->dikumpulkan_at,
            ];
        }
        return $hasil;
    }
}
```

class BadgeService
{
    public const AMBANG_EMAS = 90.0;
    public const AMBANG_PERAK = 75.0;
    public const AMBANG_PERUNGGU = 60.0;

    public function untukMurid(Murid $murid): array
    {
        $attempts = Attempt::query()
            ->where('student_id', $murid->getKey())
            ->where('jenis', JenisAttempt::Ulangan->value)
            ->where('asli', true)
            ->whereNotNull('dikumpulkan_at')
            ->with(['kuis.mapel'])
            ->get();

        $kelompok = [];
        foreach ($attempts as $attempt) {
            $mapel = $attempt->kuis?->mapel;
            $kunci = (int) ($mapel?->getKey() ?? 0);
            $nama = $mapel?->nama ?? 'Tanpa mapel';
            if (! isset($kelompok[$kunci])) {
                $kelompok[$kunci] = ['mapel_id' => $mapel?->getKey(), 'mapel_nama' => $nama, 'jumlah_ulangan' => 0, 'total_persen' => 0.0, 'total_skor' => 0.0, 'total_maks' => 0.0];
            }
            $maks = (float) $attempt->skor_maksimal;
            $persen = $maks > 0 ? (float)$attempt->skor / $maks * 100 : 0.0;
            $kelompok[$kunci]['jumlah_ulangan']++;
            $kelompok[$kunci]['total_persen'] += $persen;
            $kelompok[$kunci]['total_skor'] += (float)$attempt->skor;
            $kelompok[$kunci]['total_maks'] += $maks;
        }
        ...
    }
}

{

        $persen >= self::AMBANG_PERAK => ['kode' => 'perak', 'label' => 'Perak', 'level' => 2],
        $persen >= self::AMBANG_PERUNGGU => ['kode' => 'perunggu', 'label' => 'Perunggu', 'level' => 1],
        default => ['kode' => 'belum', 'label' => 'Belum ada', 'level' => 0],
    };
}

```php
class LaporanTagService
{
    public function __construct(private readonly PengaturanService $pengaturan) {}

    /** @return array{ambang_paham:int, ambang_mulai_paham:int, data_minimum:int} */
    public function ambang(int $sekolahId, ?int $kelasId = null, ?int $kuisId = null): array
    {
        $peta = $this->pengaturan->semua($sekolahId, $kelasId, $kuisId)['pengaturan'];
        return [
            'ambang_paham' => (int) ($peta[KunciPengaturan::AmbangPaham->value]['nilai'] ?? 80),
            'ambang_mulai_paham' => (int) (...),
            'data_minimum' => (int) (...),
        ];
    }

    public function untukMurid(Murid $murid, array $ambang): array
    {
        $attempts = Attempt::query()
            ->where('student_id', $murid->getKey())
            ->where('jenis', JenisAttempt::Ulangan->value)
            ->where('asli', true)
            ->whereNotNull('dikumpulkan_at')
            ->with(['jawaban', 'kuis.soal.tag'])
            ->get();

        $tema = [];
        foreach ($attempts as $attempt) {
            $kuis = $attempt->kuis;
            $jawaban = $attempt->jawaban->keyBy('question_id');
            foreach ($kuis->soal as $soal) {
                $tag = $soal->tag;
                if ($tag === null) continue;
                $kunci = $tag->getKey();
                $tema[$kunci] ??= ['tag_id'=>$tag->getKey(), 'tag_nama'=>$tag->nama, 'jumlah'=>0, 'benar'=>0];
                $tema[$kunci]['jumlah']++;
                $baris = $jawaban->get($soal->getKey());
                if ($baris?->benar === true) $tema[$kunci]['benar']++;
            }
        }
        // hitung tingkat
        foreach ($tema as $k => $t) {
            $persen = $t['jumlah'] > 0 ? round($t['benar']/$t['jumlah']*100,1) : 0.0;
            $tema[$k]['persen'] = $persen;
            $tema[$k]['tingkat'] = $this->tingkat($t['jumlah'], $persen, $ambang);
        }
        usort...
        return array_values($tema);
    }

    public function tingkat(int $jumlah, float $persen, array $ambang): string
    {
        if ($jumlah < $ambang['data_minimum']) return 'data_belum_cukup';
        if ($persen >= $ambang['ambang_paham']) return 'paham';
        if ($persen >= $ambang['ambang_mulai_paham']) return 'mulai_paham';
        return 'belum_paham';
    }
}
```

Also label map: paham → 'Paham', mulai_paham → 'Mulai paham', belum_paham → 'Belum paham', data_belum_cukup → 'Data belum cukup'.

protected function handleLazyLoadingViolation($key)
{
    if (isset(static::$lazyLoadingViolationCallback)) {
        return call_user_func(static::$lazyLoadingViolationCallback, $this, $key);
    }

    if (! $this->exists || $this->wasRecentlyCreated) {
        return;
    }

    throw new LazyLoadingViolationException($this, $key);
}
```

function siapkanKuis05(object $ctx, array $ubah = []): array
{
    $kuis = Kuis::factory()->untukSekolah($ctx->sekolah, $ctx->mapel, $ctx->kelas)->berjalan()->create([

function kerjakan05(object $ctx, Kuis $kuis, Murid $murid, array $jawaban = []): Attempt
{
    auth()->forgetGuards();
    Sanctum::actingAs($murid->user);
    $mulai = test()->postJson("/api/v1/kuis/{$kuis->id}/mulai")->assertCreated();
    $attemptId = (int) $mulai->json('id');
    foreach ($jawaban as $soalId => $nilai) {
        test()->postJson("/api/v1/attempt/{$attemptId}/jawab", ['question_id' => $soalId, 'jawaban' => $nilai])->assertOk();
    }
    test()->postJson("/api/v1/attempt/{$attemptId}/kumpulkan", ['idempotency_key' => 'kunci-'.uniqid()])->assertOk();
    return Attempt::query()->findOrFail($attemptId);
}
```

```js
/** Label & kelas CSS untuk tingkat pemahaman. */
export function tingkatTampilan(tingkat) {
  switch (tingkat) {
    case 'paham': return { label: 'Paham', kelas: 'badge-status sukses' }
    case 'mulai_paham': return { label: 'Mulai paham', kelas: 'badge-status peringatan' }
    case 'belum_paham': return { label: 'Belum paham', kelas: 'badge-status salah' }
    default: return { label: 'Data belum cukup', kelas: 'badge-status lembut' }
  }
}

/** Kelas CSS lencana badge (emas/perak/perunggu/belum). */
export function kelasLencana(lencana) {
  switch (lencana?.kode) {
    case 'emas': return 'lencana lencana-emas'
    case 'perak': return 'lencana lencana-perak'
    case 'perunggu': return 'lencana lencana-perunggu'
    default: return 'lencana lencana-pendukung'
  }
}

/** Ringkasan jumlah per tingkat dari daftar tema. */
export function ringkasTingkat(tema) { ... }

/** Urutan peringkat: sudah dari server; sediakan pengurutan sisi klien untuk penyajian ulang. */
export function urutkanPeringkat(daftar) {
  return [...daftar].sort((a, b) => b.skor - a.skor || a.detik - b.detik || a.nama.localeCompare(b.nama))
}
```

```js
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process'
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'

const SRC = path.resolve('src')
const TUJUAN = path.join(SRC, '__tests__')

function daftarTest(dir, hasil = []) { ... recursive ... }

const berkas = []
;(function jelajah(dir) {
  for (const nama of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    if (nama.name === '__tests__' || nama.name === 'node_modules') continue
    const p = path.join(dir, nama.name)
    if (nama.isDirectory()) jelajah(p)
    else if (/\.test\.(js|jsx)$/.test(nama.name)) berkas.push(p)
  }
})(SRC)
```

```php
public static function kemiripanKata(string $baku, string $jawaban): float
{
    $a = self::kata($baku); $b = self::kata($jawaban);
    if ($a === [] || $b === []) return 0.0;
    $cocok = 0;
    foreach ($a as $kata) {
        foreach ($b as $i => $lain) {
            if (self::mirip($kata, $lain)) { $cocok++; unset($b[$i]); break; }
        }
    }
    return $cocok / max(count($a), count($b));  // hmm
}
```

`mirip($x,$y)`: identical → true; if both numeric → false (numbers must be exact); else similar_text percent >= 80.

Whole-string fallback: `similar_text` percent of the normalized strings >= ambang*100 → true. Include that too, but careful about negation guard (applied before).

```php
final class PenilaiSoal
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly PenilaianObjektif $objektif,
        private readonly PenilaianTeks $teks,
    ) {}

    public function nilai(Soal $soal, mixed $jawaban): array
    {
        $tipe = $soal->tipeAman();
        if ($tipe === null) return Gagal;
        return $tipe->objektif() ? $this->objektif->nilai($soal,$jawaban) : $this->teks->nilai($soal,$jawaban);
    }
}
```

```php
class KoreksiService
{
    public function __construct(private readonly TokenKonfirmasiService $token) {}

    public function antrean(Kuis $kuis): array
    {
        $kuis->loadMissing(['mapel','kelas','soal']);
        $baris = Jawaban::query()
            ->whereIn('status', [PerluTinjau->value, Gagal->value])
            ->whereHas('attempt', fn($q) => $q->where('quiz_id', $kuis->getKey())->whereNotNull('dikumpulkan_at'))
            ->with(['attempt.murid.user', 'soal'])
            ->get();
        map...
    }

    public function koreksi(User $guru, Attempt $attempt, Soal $soal, float $skor, string $alasan, string $token, ?string $ip): Jawaban
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use (...) {
            $this->token->pakai($guru, TUJUAN_KOREKSI, $token, ['attempt_id' => $attempt->getKey(), 'question_id' => $soal->getKey()]);
            $baris = Jawaban::query()->where('attempt_id',...)->where('question_id',...)->lockForUpdate()->first();
            if ($baris === null) throw ValidationException...
            $maks = (float) $soal->skor;
            $skor = max(0, min($skor, $maks));
            $baris->forceFill([...'status'=>Dinilai,'skor'=>$skor,'benar'=>$skor >= $maks && $maks>0,'dinilai_manual'=>true,'alasan_koreksi'=>$alasan,'dinilai_at'=>now()])->save();
            $this->hitungUlang($attempt);
            activity(...)->log('Koreksi nilai manual');
            return $baris->refresh();
        });
    }

    public function hitungUlang(Attempt $attempt): Attempt
    {
        $attempt = Attempt::query()->whereKey(...)->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();
        $skor = (float) $attempt->jawaban()->sum('skor');
        $benar = (int) $attempt->jawaban()->where('benar', true)->count();
        $attempt->forceFill(['skor'=>$skor,'jumlah_benar'=>$benar])->save();
        return $attempt->refresh();
    }
}
```

```php
function buatSoal06(object $ctx, string $tipe, array $konten, array $kunci, int $skor = 4): Soal
{
    auth()->forgetGuards();
    Sanctum::actingAs($ctx->guru);

    $respons = test()->postJson('/api/v1/soal', [
        'subject_id' => $ctx->mapel->id,
        'tipe' => $tipe,
        'konten' => $konten,
        'kunci' => $kunci,
        'skor' => $skor,
    ])->assertCreated();

    return Soal::query()->findOrFail((int) $respons->json('id'));
}

function kuis06(object $ctx, array $soal): Kuis
{
    $kuis = Kuis::factory()->untukSekolah($ctx->sekolah, $ctx->mapel, $ctx->kelas)->berjalan()->create([
        'acak_soal' => false, 'acak_opsi' => false,
    ]);

    foreach ($soal as $urutan => $satu) {
        $kuis->soal()->attach($satu->id, ['urutan' => $urutan + 1]);
    }

    return $kuis->refresh();
}

function kerjakan06(object $ctx, Kuis $kuis, Murid $murid, array $jawaban): Attempt
{
    auth()->forgetGuards();
    Sanctum::actingAs($murid->user);
    $mulai = test()->postJson("/api/v1/kuis/{$kuis->id}/mulai")->assertCreated();
    $attemptId = (int) $mulai->json('id');
    foreach ($jawaban as $soalId => $nilai) {
        test()->postJson("/api/v1/attempt/{$attemptId}/jawab", ['question_id' => $soalId, 'jawaban' => $nilai])->assertOk();
    }
    test()->postJson("/api/v1/attempt/{$attemptId}/kumpulkan", ['idempotency_key' => 'kunci-'.uniqid()])->assertOk();
    return Attempt::query()->findOrFail($attemptId);
}
```

```js
export function kunciDariState(state) {
  if (state.tipe === TIPE.benarSalah) return { benar: state.benar }
  if (state.tipe === TIPE.menjodohkan) return { pasangan: { ...state.pasangan } }
  if (state.tipe === TIPE.mengurutkan) return { urutan: urutanDariItem(state.item) }
  if (state.tipe === TIPE.letakKata) return { penempatan: { ...state.penempatan } }
  if (state.tipe === TIPE.hubungKata) return { sambungan: { ...state.sambungan } }
  if (state.tipe === TIPE.isianSingkat) return kunciIsian(state)
  if (state.tipe === TIPE.uraian) return kunciUraian(state)
  return { jawaban: state.jawaban }
}
```

with helpers:

```js
export function kunciIsian(state) {
  const kunci = {
    jawaban_baku: state.jawabanBaku.map((satu) => satu.teks.trim()),
  }

  const sinonim = state.jawabanBaku.map((satu) =>
    satu.sinonim.split(',').map((alias) => alias.trim()).filter((alias) => alias !== ''),
  )
  if (sinonim.some((daftar) => daftar.length > 0)) kunci.sinonim = sinonim
  if (state.angkaPersis) kunci.angka_persis = true
  const ambang = Number(state.ambang)
  if (Number.isFinite(ambang) && ambang > 0 && ambang <= 1) kunci.ambang = ambang
  const negasi = daftarKata(state.negasi)
  if (negasi.length > 0) kunci.negasi = negasi
  return kunci
}
```
Hmm angka_persis: default backend is true. Only emit when false? Backend: `$angkaPersis = $kunci['angka_persis'] ?? true;`. Emitting true is harmless. But cleaner to emit only when false: `if (!state.angkaPersis) kunci.angka_persis = false`. Yes.

```js
export function kunciUraian(state) {
  const kunci = {
    kata_kunci: state.kataKunci.map((satu) => {
      const bobot = Number(satu.bobot)
      return Number.isFinite(bobot) && bobot > 0 && satu.bobot.trim() !== ''
        ? { teks: satu.teks.trim(), bobot }
        : { teks: satu.teks.trim() }
    }),
  }
  const ambang = Number(state.ambangLulus)
  if (state.ambangLulus.trim() !== '' && Number.isFinite(ambang) && ambang > 0 && ambang <= 1) kunci.ambang_lulus = ambang
  const sinonim = sinonimUraian(state.sinonimUraian)
  if (Object.keys(sinonim).length > 0) kunci.sinonim = sinonim
  return kunci
}
```

 * }} props

function FieldsetPasangan({ state, ubah, namaPeta, judul }) {
  const peta = state[namaPeta]

  /** @param {number} index @param {string} teks */
  function ubahKiri(index, teks) {
    ubah({ kiri: state.kiri.map((satu, posisi) => (posisi === index ? { ...satu, teks } : satu)) })
  }

  /** @param {number} index */
  function hapusKiri(index) {
    if (state.kiri.length <= MIN_ITEM) return
    const dibuang = state.kiri[index]
    const baru = { ...peta }
    delete baru[dibuang.id]

  /** @param {number} index @param {string} teks */
  function ubahKanan(index, teks) {
    ubah({ kanan: state.kanan.map((satu, posisi) => (posisi === index ? { ...satu, teks } : satu)) })
  }

  /** @param {number} index */
  function hapusKanan(index) {
    if (state.kanan.length <= MIN_ITEM) return
    const dibuang = state.kanan[index]
    const baru = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(peta).filter(([, ke]) => ke !== dibuang.id))
    ubah({ kanan: state.kanan.filter((_, posisi) => posisi !== index), [namaPeta]: baru })
  }

  return ( ...jsx... )
}

```js
export function jawabanTeks(jawaban) {
  if (jawaban === null || jawaban === undefined) return '(belum dijawab)'
  if (typeof jawaban === 'boolean') return jawaban ? 'Benar' : 'Salah'
  if (typeof jawaban === 'string') return jawaban.trim() === '' ? '(kosong)' : jawaban
  if (typeof jawaban === 'number') return String(jawaban)
  if (Array.isArray(jawaban)) return jawaban.map(...).join(', ')
  // peta id->nilai
  return Object.entries(jawaban).map(([k,v]) => `${k} → ${jawabanTeks(v)}`).join(', ')
}

export function ringkasKunci(kunci) {
  if (kunci === null || typeof kunci !== 'object') return '—'
  return Object.entries(kunci).map(([k,v]) => `${k}: ${ringkasNilai(v)}`).join(' · ')
}
```

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import { jawabanTeks, kelasStatus, ringkasKunci } from '../../../sections/scoring/tampilan.js'

describe('jawabanTeks', () => {
  it('menandai jawaban kosong dan belum dijawab', () => {
    expect(jawabanTeks(null)).toBe('(belum dijawab)')
    expect(jawabanTeks(undefined)).toBe('(belum dijawab)')
    expect(jawabanTeks('   ')).toBe('(kosong)')
  })
  it('menampilkan boolean, angka, dan teks apa adanya', () => {
    expect(jawabanTeks(true)).toBe('Benar')
    expect(jawabanTeks(false)).toBe('Salah')
    expect(jawabanTeks(9)).toBe('9')
    expect(jawabanTeks('sembilan')).toBe('sembilan')
  })
  it('meringkas daftar dan peta jawaban bertingkat', () => {
    expect(jawabanTeks(['I2','I1'])).toBe('I2, I1')
    expect(jawabanTeks({ K1: 'N2', K2: 'N1' })).toBe('K1 → N2, K2 → N1')
    expect(jawabanTeks({ K1: null })).toBe('K1 → (belum dijawab)')
  })
})

describe('ringkasKunci', () => {
  it('menggabungkan bidang kunci jadi satu baris', () => {
    expect(ringkasKunci({ jawaban: 'B' })).toBe('jawaban: B')
    expect(ringkasKunci({ pasangan: { K1: 'N1' } })).toBe('pasangan: K1 → N1')
  })
  it('memberi tanda pisah untuk kunci kosong atau bukan objek', () => {
    expect(ringkasKunci({})).toBe('—')
    expect(ringkasKunci(null)).toBe('—')
    expect(ringkasKunci(['a'])).toBe('—')
  })
})

describe('kelasStatus', () => {
  it('memetakan status antrean ke kelas lencana', () => {
    expect(kelasStatus('perlu_tinjau')).toBe('badge-status peringatan')
    expect(kelasStatus('gagal')).toBe('badge-status salah')
    expect(kelasStatus('dinilai')).toBe('badge-status lembut')
  })
})
```

}

Simpler approach that keeps behavior: keep calling `ambilCsrfCookie()` but make it idempotent/cached:

```js
let janjiCsrf = null
export async function ambilCsrfCookie({ segarkan = false } = {}) {
  if (segarkan) janjiCsrf = null
  janjiCsrf ??= axiosRoot.get('/sanctum/csrf-cookie').catch((g) => { janjiCsrf = null; throw g })

}
```

And kirimUlangPublik:
```php
    /**
     * Kirim ulang tautan verifikasi TANPA sesi (akun pending yang belum bisa masuk).
     * Penelusuran email + penjaga status sengaja di sini (bukan di controller)
     * supaya controller hanya bicara dengan service.
     */
    public function kirimUlangPublik(string $email): void
    {
        $email = mb_strtolower(trim($email));

        if ($email === '') {
            return;
        }

        $user = User::query()->where('email', $email)->first();

        // Pending (belum verifikasi) justru yang boleh kirim ulang; suspend/dihapus tidak.
        if ($user === null) {
            return;
        }

        if (in_array($user->status, [UserStatus::Suspended, UserStatus::Dihapus], true)) {
            return;
        }

        $this->kirimUlang($user);
    }
```

`skemaEmail` ends with `.pipe(z.email(...))` — adding `.toLowerCase()` before the pipe: `z.string().trim().toLowerCase().min(1)...` — but note the order: `.toLowerCase()` is a transform; transforms in Zod v4 string helpers are applied at parse time, and chaining `.min()` after a transform... In Zod v4, `z.string().trim()` is also a transform, and the code already chains `.trim().min(1)` (works because these string-format helpers return ZodString with transformations applied in order, not ZodEffects). So `.trim().toLowerCase().min(1).max(120).pipe(z.email())` should work.

Then the call sites can drop `.toLowerCase()`... but they'd send `data.email` from the form which HAS been through Zod (RHF+zodResolver) → already lowercase ✓. Better: do the SSE check from Node (outside evalJs) using global fetch + AbortController:
```js
const pengawas = new AbortController()
const aliran = await fetch(`${REALTIME}/sse/monitor?tiket=${tiket.isi.tiket}`, { signal: pengawas.signal })
const pembaca = aliran.body.getReader()
const { value } = await pembaca.read()
const teks = new TextDecoder().decode(value ?? new Uint8Array())
pengawas.abort()
catat('SSE menyambung dengan tiket sekali pakai', aliran.status === 200 && teks.includes('event: siap'))
// pakai ulang
const ulang = await fetch(`${REALTIME}/sse/monitor?tiket=${tiket.isi.tiket}`)
catat('tiket SSE tidak bisa dipakai dua kali', ulang.status === 401)
```
The Origin header: Node checks only if origin header present; fetch from Node sends no Origin → allowed. Good (documented behavior).

**Thinking (mentah):**

Confirmed: the Node process **crashed** with "Connection is closed." from ioredis. This happened when my cleanup ran: `pendengar.disconnect()` — ioredis's `disconnect()` closes the socket, and pending queued commands (the `subscribe` we awaited, or `unsubscribe`) throw an unhandled error that crashes the process.

Root cause: calling `disconnect()` while operations are queued causes ioredis to `flushQueue(new Error(CONNECTION_CLOSED_ERROR_MSG))` → unhandled promise rejection → process exit.

This is a **real bug** in my SSE cleanup path that would crash the realtime service in production whenever a guru closes the Live Monitor tab. That's exactly the kind of thing the smoke test caught. 

Fix: 
- Use `quit()` (graceful) instead of `disconnect()`, and await it; wrap in try/catch.
- Better: `unsubscribe()` first, then `quit()`. And attach the `error` handler to the subscriber so errors don't crash.
- Add a global safety: `process.on('unhandledRejection')`? Better to fix the cause: don't call disconnect during pending ops; use `quit()` inside an async function with catch, and also add `pendengar.on('error', ...)` so ioredis errors are handled (an unhandled 'error' event on an EventEmitter throws).

Actually the crash trace shows the error was thrown from within ioredis's close handler → it's the flushQueue rejecting queued commands. Those queued commands' promises are ours (the awaited subscribe) — but we await subscribe before registering the cleanup... Not necessarily: if the client closes while `subscribe` is still queued, the promise rejects → we catch it (in the try) — hmm, we do catch subscribe errors. But the trace shows `flushQueue` throwing synchronously inside the socket close handler, i.e. the rejection happens for a command whose promise has no handler → unhandledRejection → Node 22 default = crash.

Which command? Possibly a second `subscribe` retry, or the `unsubscribe` call I fire-and-forget in the cleanup (`pendengar.unsubscribe?.(...)` without await/catch!). Yes — in `bersihkan()` I call `pendengar.unsubscribe(...)` without catching its promise, then `disconnect()`. The unsubscribe promise rejects when the connection is closed → unhandled rejection → crash.

Fixes:
1. In `bersihkan`, await/catch properly: make it async-safe:
```js
const bersihkan = () => {
  clearInterval(keepalive)
  if (sudahBersih) return
  sudahBersih = true
  pendengar.removeListener?.('message', teruskan)
  // Lepas langganan lalu tutup dengan sopan; semua promise ditangani supaya
  // penutupan koneksi tidak pernah menjatuhkan service.
  Promise.resolve()
    .then(() => pendengar.unsubscribe?.(...kanal))
    .catch(() => {})
    .finally(() => {
      try { pendengar.quit?.() } catch {}
    })
}
```
2. Add `pendengar.on('error', ...)` to swallow connection errors on the subscriber.
3. Guard double cleanup (both `request.raw.on('close')` and `reply.raw.on('close')` fire).

Also for the main `redis` client, `redis.disconnect()` in onClose hook is fine.

Hmm, `ambilAliran` calls `app.listen({port:0})` each time. For the http helper I need the server listening first. Let me structure: `await app.listen({ port: 0, host: '127.0.0.1' })`, get port, then http.get with headers.

Let me write it as:
```js
/**
 * @param {import('fastify').FastifyInstance} app
 * @param {string} url
 * @param {Record<string,string>} headers
 */
async function ambilHeader(app, url, headers) {
  await app.listen({ port: 0, host: '127.0.0.1' })
  const alamat = app.server.address()
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const req = http.request(
      { host: '127.0.0.1', port: alamat.port, path: url, headers },
      (res) => {
        res.once('data', () => {
          resolve({ status: res.statusCode, headers: res.headers })
          req.destroy()
        })
        res.once('end', () => resolve({ status: res.statusCode, headers: res.headers }))
      },
    )
    req.on('error', reject)
    req.end()
  })
}
```

it('handshake mengirim Access-Control-Allow-Origin agar EventSource tidak diblokir browser', async () => {
  const tiket = 'f'.repeat(64)
  const isi = { [`sse:tiket:${hashTiket(tiket)}`]: JSON.stringify({ user_id: 7, quiz_id: 1 }) }
  const { utama } = redisTiruan({ isi })
  const app = buildApp({ logger: false, redis: utama })

  const respons = await ambilHeader(app, `/sse/monitor?tiket=${tiket}`, { Origin: 'http://localhost:5173' })

  assert.equal(respons.status, 200)
  // Tanpa header ini browser memblokir aliran walau status 200 (bukan 403),
  // dan Live Monitor turun ke polling tanpa guru sadar.
  assert.equal(respons.headers['access-control-allow-origin'], 'http://localhost:5173')
  assert.equal(respons.headers['vary'], 'Origin')

  await app.close()
})

it('respons JSON juga membawa Access-Control-Allow-Origin untuk origin yang diizinkan', async () => {
  const { utama } = redisTiruan({ isi: {} })
  const app = buildApp({ logger: false, redis: utama })
  const respons = await app.inject({ method: 'GET', url: `/sse/monitor?tiket=${'g'.repeat(64)}`, headers: { origin: 'http://localhost:5173' } })
  assert.equal(respons.statusCode, 401)
  assert.equal(respons.headers['access-control-allow-origin'], 'http://localhost:5173')
  await app.close()
})
```

If there's no `Origin` header (e.g., a server-side request, curl, or a malicious page that... hmm, browsers always send Origin for cross-origin requests including EventSource). OK. But here's a real bug: **`redis.getdel`** — `GETDEL` requires Redis 6.2+. ioredis supports it. If the Redis version is older, it throws → caught → 503. Fine.

Another: **`retryStrategy: () => null`** means the main redis connection never reconnects after failure. `lazyConnect: true` + `retryStrategy: () => null` → once the connection drops, ioredis won't retry, and `redis.status` becomes 'end'. Then `redis.status === 'waiting'` is false, so we call `redis.getdel(...)` on an ended connection → ioredis with maxRetriesPerRequest: 1 → throws "Connection is closed." → caught → 503. Hmm, but `redis.connect()` is never retried. So after the first Redis hiccup, realtime stays broken until restart. That's a real robustness issue. Tradeoff: changing retryStrategy alters behavior. ## 1. Perbaikan dari zip — diterapkan apa adanya
- `AppServiceProvider`: tautan verifikasi pakai **tanda tangan relatif** (`URL::temporarySignedRoute(..., false)`) + limiter `verifikasi-klik` 120/menit — murid satu kelas di belakang NAT sekolah (satu IP) tidak lagi kena 429 hanya karena menekan tautan bersamaan.
- `bootstrap/app.php`: `InvalidSignatureException` pada rute `verification.verify` → **redirect ke halaman frontend**, bukan JSON 403 mentah.
- `routes/api.php`: `signed` → `signed:relative`.
- `HalamanVerifikasiEmail.jsx`: segarkan user setelah `?status=berhasil` (tanpa ini, tombol “Masuk sekarang” memantul balik ke `/perlu-verifikasi`).
- 3 test regresi baru (host berbeda, tautan kedaluwarsa) — **31 test auth lulus**.

## 2. Bug yang saya temukan sendiri & perbaiki

**#1 — Fitur isian singkat & uraian tidak bisa diterbitkan (berat).**
`KuisService::galatKelengkapan()` masih menolak semua soal non-objektif: *“Tahap ini baru mendukung soal objektif (…)”.* Jadi guru yang menyusun kuis berisi uraian/isian dan menekan **Terbitkan** dapat 422 — padahal penilaian bertingkat + antrean koreksi sudah ada sejak slice 06. Test slice 06 tidak menangkapnya karena helper `kuisSoal06()` membuat kuis lewat factory `berjalan()`, mem-bypass endpoint publikasi.
→ Saya buktikan dulu (test baru **merah** dengan 422 asli), lalu ganti penjaganya menjadi “jenisnya dikenal mesin penilaian” (`RegistryTipeSoal::dukung`) + pakai `tipeAman()` agar baris bertipe rusak tidak melempar `ValueError`. Test sekarang **hijau**.

**#2 — Jawaban terakhir hilang diam-diam saat “Kumpulkan”.**
`kumpulkan()` di `HalamanKerjakan.jsx` mengabaikan hasil `kirimAntrean`: kalau jaringan putus tepat saat menekan Kumpulkan, jawaban yang gagal terkirim tidak pernah masuk, attempt tetap dikumpulkan, **cadangan lokal dihapus**, dan murid dinilai 0 untuk soal itu.
→ Sekarang kumpul manual mencoba ulang antrean (3× dengan jeda 700 ms), dan bila masih gagal **tidak** mengumpulkan: muncul pesan “Sebagian jawaban belum tersimpan…”. Cadangan lokal hanya dihapus bila semua benar-benar tersimpan. Kumpul otomatis saat waktu habis tetap mengirim apa adanya (perilaku lama dipertahankan — kalau tidak, murid bisa macet tak bisa submit).

**#3 — Kunci layar `focus_lock` habis jauh lebih cepat dari 60 detik.**
Tiap `blur` memasang interval baru tanpa mematikan yang lama; keluar jendela 3× = hitungan 3× lebih cepat.
→ Sekarang satu penghitung saja.

**#4 — Effect presence bongkar-pasang di setiap render.**
`usePresence` memakai nilai bawaan `jam = () => Date.now()` di destructuring → referensi baru tiap render → 3 pendengar `window` dilepas-dipasang terus dan jendela 15 detik direset, sehingga ping penambal praktis tak pernah jalan.
→ Jam bawaan diangkat jadi satu referensi modul.

## 3. Verifikasi (dijalankan ulang setelah semua edit)
`./verify.sh` **exit 0**: Pest **110 lulus / 753 assertion** (107 → 110), Pint PASS 203 berkas, checkJs OK, ESLint 0 error (2 warning lama `watch()` RHF), Vitest 29 berkas / 209 test, realtime 11 test. Setelah edit frontend terakhir saya jalankan ulang checkJs + ESLint + Vitest: **hijau**. `route:cache`/`optimize:clear` juga sukses dengan rute baru.

## 4. Tradeoff yang saya temukan tapi **sengaja tidak** saya sentuh
1. **Redis realtime tidak auto-reconnect** (`retryStrategy: () => null`). Setelah Redis restart, `/sse/monitor` balas 503 terus sampai service Node dijalankan ulang — Live Monitor nyangkut di mode polling. Memperbaikinya berarti menukar fail-fast 503 dengan `connect()` yang bisa menggantung; itu menyentuh inti perilaku fail-open slice 07, jadi saya lepaskan.
2. **Race tulis peta presence** (`Cache::get` → ubah → `Cache::put` tanpa lock). Dua murid yang ping bersamaan bisa saling menimpa sehingga lencana “online” salah. memperbaikinya menambah kunci di jalur panas yang dipanggil setiap request attempt; dampaknya hanya kosmetik di layar guru.
3. **`LaporanTagService::untukKuis` N+1** — satu set query berat per murid. Untuk 40 murid ini pelan; perbaikannya perlu agregasi ulang di SQL.
4. **Attempt macet**: attempt `aktif` yang ditinggalkan melewati deadline tidak pernah ditutup, sehingga murid itu tidak bisa mencoba lagi selamanya (tombol Mulai menyulut attempt lama). Perlu job pembersih/auto-kumpul — perubahan kebijakan, bukan sekadar tambalan.
5. **Tenancy ringan**: `KuisService::sinkronSoal` memvalidasi soal hanya dengan `exists:questions,id`, tidak `school_id`. Aman sekarang (aplikasi satu sekolah), berbahaya bila multi-sekolah.
6. Dua fix frontend (#2, #3) **belum punya test otomatis**: repo ini tidak memakai `@testing-library/react`, jadi mengujinya berarti menambah dependensi baru. Saya tidak melakukannya sesuai aturan repo.

    /**

     *
     * @return int jumlah attempt yang ditutup
     */
    public function tutupSemuaBasi(): int
    {
        $batas = Carbon::now()->subSeconds(self::TENGGAT_TERLAMBAT);

        $jumlah = 0;

        Attempt::query()
            ->where('aktif', true)
            ->where('status', StatusAttempt::Berjalan->value)
            ->where('deadline_at', '<', $batas)
            ->orderBy('id')
            ->chunkById(200, function ($daftar) use (&$jumlah): void {
                foreach ($daftar as $satu) {
                    $this->tutupBasi($satu);
                    $jumlah++;
                }
            });

        return $jumlah;
    }

    /**
     * Kumpulkan jawaban + nilai. Idempoten: menekan dua kali atau dua tab
     * mengembalikan hasil yang sama tanpa menggandakan penilaian.
     *
     * @throws ValidationException
     */
    public function kumpulkan(Attempt $attempt, string $idempotencyKey): Attempt
    {
        return $this->tutup($attempt, $idempotencyKey, false);
    }

    /**
     * Apakah attempt ini ditinggalkan jauh melewati tenggat keterlambatan?
     *
     * Attempt seperti ini tidak bisa menyimpan jawaban (deadline lewat) maupun
     * dikumpulkan (lewat toleransi), tetapi kolom `aktif` masih terisi sehingga
     * `mulai()` selalu mengembalikannya — murid mentok dan tidak pernah bisa
     * mencoba lagi.
     */
    public function basi(Attempt $attempt, ?Carbon $sekarang = null): bool
    {
        $sekarang ??= Carbon::now();

        return $attempt->berjalan()
            && $sekarang->greaterThan($attempt->deadline_at->copy()->addSeconds(self::TENGGAT_TERLAMBAT));
    }

    /**
     * Tutup attempt yang ditinggalkan TANPA menolak karena keterlambatan.
     *
     * Jawaban yang sempat tersimpan tetap dinilai seperti pengumpulan biasa,
     * jadi hasilnya jujur: murid yang keluar sendiri mendapat nilai apa adanya.
     */
    public function tutupBasi(Attempt $attempt): Attempt
    {
        return $this->tutup($attempt, 'basi-'.$attempt->getKey(), true);
    }

    /**
     * Tutup semua attempt berjalan yang sudah melewati tenggat keterlambatan.
     * Dipanggil penjadwal (lihat `TutupAttemptBasi`) supaya layar guru tidak
     * menampilkan murid "mengerjakan" berjam-jam setelah waktunya habis.
     *
     * @return int jumlah attempt yang ditutup
     */
    public function tutupSemuaBasi(): int
    {
        $batas = Carbon::now()->subSeconds(self::TENGGAT_TERLAMBAT);
        $jumlah = 0;

        Attempt::query()
            ->where('aktif', true)
            ->where('status', StatusAttempt::Berjalan->value)
            ->where('deadline_at', '<', $batas)
            ->chunkById(200, function (Collection $daftar) use (&$jumlah): void {
                /** @var Attempt $satu */
                foreach ($daftar as $satu) {
                    $this->tutupBasi($satu);
                    $jumlah++;
                }
            });

        return $jumlah;
    }

    /**

    private function tutup(Attempt $attempt, string $idempotencyKey, bool $abaikanToleransi): Attempt
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($attempt, $idempotencyKey, $abaikanToleransi): Attempt {
            $terkunci = Attempt::query()->whereKey($attempt->getKey())->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();

            if (! $terkunci->berjalan()) {
                return $this->muatHasil($terkunci);
            }

            $sekarang = Carbon::now();
            $terlambat = $sekarang->greaterThan($terkunci->deadline_at);

            if (! $abaikanToleransi && $terlambat && $sekarang->greaterThan($terkunci->deadline_at->copy()->addSeconds(self::TENGGAT_TERLAMBAT))) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'attempt' => 'Waktu ulangan sudah habis jauh; jawaban tidak bisa dikumpulkan lagi.',
                ]);
            }
            ... rest identical ...

Test A: murid yang menutup tab mid-exam tidak mentok
```php
it('attempt yang ditinggalkan jauh lewat deadline ditutup otomatis dan murid bisa mencoba lagi', function (): void {
    $kuis = siapkanKuis($this);
    $hasil = mulaiUlangan($this, $kuis);
    $soalId = (int) $hasil['soal'][0]['id'];

    // Jawaban sempat tersimpan sebelum murid menutup tab.
    $this->postJson("/api/v1/attempt/{$hasil['attempt']}/jawab", [
        'question_id' => $soalId,
        'jawaban' => 'a',
    ])->assertOk();

    // Tab ditutup lalu dibuka lagi 10 menit setelah deadline (di luar toleransi 120 detik).
    Attempt::query()->whereKey($hasil['attempt'])->update(['deadline_at' => Carbon::now()->subMinutes(10)]);

    auth()->forgetGuards();
    Sanctum::actingAs($this->murid->user);
    $kedua = $this->postJson("/api/v1/kuis/{$kuis->id}/mulai")->assertCreated();

    $lama = Attempt::query()->findOrFail($hasil['attempt']);
    expect((int) $kedua->json('id'))->not->toBe($hasil['attempt'])
        ->and($lama->status->value)->toBe('selesai')
        ->and($lama->aktif)->toBeNull()
        ->and($lama->terlambat)->toBeTrue()
        ->and($lama->dikumpulkan_at)->not->toBeNull()
        // Jawaban yang sempat tersimpan tetap dinilai, bukan dibuang.
        ->and((int) $lama->jawaban()->count())->toBe(2)
        ->and((int) $kedua->json('attempt_no'))->toBe(2);
});
```

The jar file format: `domain  flag  path  secure  expiry  name  value` → fields: 1=domain,2=flag,3=path,4=secure,5=expiry,6=name,7=value. So `awk '{print $7}'` is right, but the line may start with `#HttpOnly_...` (no leading # stripping needed) — the domain field could be `localhost` or `127.0.0.1`. Also there might be a `#HttpOnly_` prefix in field 1 for HttpOnly cookies (XSRF-TOKEN isn't HttpOnly; `ulangan_sekolah_session` is). So grep XSRF-TOKEN should match the right line.

Possibility: the cookie jar didn't get XSRF-TOKEN because the request to `/sanctum/csrf-cookie` on 127.0.0.1 — SESSION_DOMAIN=localhost, so the session cookie is set for domain `localhost`, and curl stores it... but with a domain mismatch, curl may reject cookies for `127.0.0.1` when the Set-Cookie has `Domain=localhost`. Yes! `SESSION_DOMAIN=localhost` → Laravel sets cookies with `domain=localhost`. When requesting `127.0.0.1`, curl refuses to store a cookie whose domain doesn't match the host (unless the domain is a suffix match). That kills the CSRF cookie.

Fix: use `http://localhost:8000` as the API base instead of 127.0.0.1, so the host matches the cookie domain. Let me also print the jar for debugging.

class SimpanCookie(urllib.request.BaseHandler):
    def __init__(self, sesi): self.sesi = sesi
    def http_request(self, req):
        if self.sesi.cookies:
            req.add_header("Cookie", "; ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in self.sesi.cookies.items()))
        return req
    def http_response(self, req, resp):
        for h in resp.headers.get_all("Set-Cookie") or []:
            pasangan = h.split(";")[0]
            if "=" in pasangan:
                k, v = pasangan.split("=", 1)
                self.sesi.cookies[k.strip()] = v.strip()
        return resp
```

Then `self.buka = urllib.request.build_opener(SimpanCookie(self))`.

And `xsrf()` reads `self.cookies.get("XSRF-TOKEN")`.

Detection order:
1. empty → tidak dikenal
2. signatures:
   - `\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n` → image/png, aman
   - `\xFF\xD8\xFF` → image/jpeg, aman
   - `GIF87a`/`GIF89a` → image/gif, aman
   - `RIFF`+`WEBP` at 8 → image/webp, aman
   - `%PDF-` → application/pdf, berisiko
   - `PK\x03\x04` → zip container: look for `[Content_Types].xml`/`word/`/`ppt/` in cuplikan → docx/xlsx/pptx, berisiko (fallback application/zip berisiko)
   - `\xD0\xCF\x11\xE0\xA1\xB1\x1A\xE1` → OLE2 → application/x-ole-storage, berisiko
   - `ftyp` at 4 → video/mp4 or audio/mp4 → aman
   - `\x1A\x45\xDF\xA3` → video/webm, aman
   - `ID3` or MPEG frame sync (\xFF\xFB) → audio/mpeg, aman
   - `OggS` → audio/ogg, aman
   - `Rar!`/7z: `7z\xBC\xAF\x27\x1C` → berisiko? -> TidakDikenal? archives: berisiko (force download) — but we can't render anyway. Set berisiko.
   - text: if all bytes printable-ish (no NUL) → text/plain aman, unless starts with `<?xml` or contains `<svg` → image/svg+xml berisiko; if contains `<html`/`<!doctype html` → text/html berisiko.
3. else TidakDikenal.

Handle webp and wav both RIFF; need custom checks. Simpler to write explicit if-chain for correctness/clarity:

```php
public function kenali(string $isi): array
{
    $a = substr($isi, 0, 16);

    if (str_starts_with($a, "\xFF\xD8\xFF")) return $this->hasil('jpg','image/jpeg',Umum);
    if (str_starts_with($a, "\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n")) return ...
    if (str_starts_with($a, 'GIF87a') || str_starts_with($a, 'GIF89a')) gif
    if (str_starts_with($a, 'RIFF')) { if (substr($a,8,4)==='WEBP') webp; if (substr($a,8,4)==='WAVE') wav; }
    if (str_starts_with($a, '%PDF-')) pdf
    if (substr($a,4,4) === 'ftyp') → mp4 (video/mp4) — but m4a is ftypM4A. Could be audio. Keep 'mp4' => 'video/mp4' with Amn? For audio m4a, mime 'audio/mp4'. Simplify: 'mp4'/'video/mp4'.
    if (str_starts_with($a, "\x1A\x45\xDF\xA3")) webm (video/webm)
    if (str_starts_with($a, 'OggS')) ogg (audio/ogg)
    if (str_starts_with($a, 'ID3') || (ord($a[0])===0xFF && (ord($a[1]) & 0xE0) === 0xE0)) mp3
    if (str_starts_with($a, "PK\x03\x04")) → zip => Berisiko, ext 'zip', mime 'application/zip'
    if (str_starts_with($a, "Rar!\x1A\x07")) rar risky
    if (str_starts_with($a, "7z\xBC\xAF\x27\x1C")) 7z risky
    // Teks berbahaya / tak dikenal: SVG & XML & HTML harus jatuh ke TidakDikenal (tidak pernah Aman).
    return hasil('bin', 'application/octet-stream', TidakDikenal);
}
```

```php
class MateriService
{
    public function __construct(private readonly PenyimpananMateri $penyimpanan) {}

    public function simpan(Sekolah $sekolah, User $pembuat, array $data): Materi
    {
        $materi = Materi::query()->create([
            'school_id' => $sekolah->getKey(),
            'subject_id' => $data['subject_id'],
            'class_id' => $data['class_id'],
            'tag_id' => $data['tag_id'] ?? null,
            'judul' => $data['judul'],
            'deskripsi' => $data['deskripsi'] ?? null,
            'status' => StatusMateri::Draf,
            'urutan' => (int) ($data['urutan'] ?? 0),
            'dibuat_oleh' => $pembuat->getKey(),
        ]);

        return $materi;
    }

    public function perbarui(Materi $materi, array $data): Materi { ... }

    public function hapus(Materi $materi): void {
        // hapus berkas
        foreach ($materi->unggahan()->get() as $u) { $this->penyimpanan->hapus($u); }
        $materi->delete();
    }

    public function sinkronBlok(Materi $materi, array $blok): Materi
    {
        DB::transaction(function () use ($materi, $blok) {
            $materi->blok()->get(); // ...
            foreach (array_values($blok) as $i => $satu) {
                $urutan = $i + 1;
                $tipe = TipeBlok::from((string) $satu['tipe']);
                $isi = null; $quizId = null;
                if ($tipe->berkuis()) { $quizId = $this->validasiKuis($materi, (int)$satu['quiz_id']); }
                else { $isi = $this->validasiIsi($materi, $tipe, (array)($satu['isi'] ?? [])); }
                BlokMateri::query()->updateOrCreate(
                    ['material_id' => $materi->getKey(), 'urutan' => $urutan],
                    ['tipe' => $tipe, 'wajib' => (bool)($satu['wajib'] ?? true), 'isi' => $isi, 'quiz_id' => $quizId],
                );
            }
            BlokMateri::query()->where('material_id', $materi->getKey())->where('urutan','>', count($blok))->delete();
        });
        return $materi->refresh()->load('blok.kuis');
    }

    public function publikasi(Materi $materi): Materi {
        // require minimal 1 blok
        if ($materi->blok()->count() === 0) throw ValidationException::withMessages(['blok' => 'Materi belum punya blok apa pun.']);
        $materi->forceFill(['status' => StatusMateri::Publikasi, 'publikasi_at' => now()])->save();
        return $materi->refresh();
    }
```

```php
class LaporanMateriService
{
    public function __construct(private readonly LaporanTagService $tag) {}

    public function untukMateri(Materi $materi): array
    {
        $materi->loadMissing(['kelas','mapel','tag','blok.kuis.soal.tag']);
        $ambang = $this->tag->ambang((int)$materi->school_id, (int)$materi->class_id, null);

        $blok = $materi->blok; // ordered

        $murid = Murid::query()->where('class_id', $materi->class_id)->with('user')->orderBy('id')->get();

        $progres = ProgresMateri::query()
            ->where('material_id', $materi->getKey())
            ->with(['attempt.jawaban'])
            ->get()
            ->groupBy('student_id');

        $daftar = [];
        foreach ($murid as $satuMurid) {
            $barisMurid = $progres->get($satuMurid->getKey()) ?? collect();
            $perBlok = [];
            $temaKumpul = []; // tag_id => ['tag_id','tag_nama','jumlah_soal','jumlah_benar']
            $selesaiWajib = 0; $jumlahWajib = 0;
            $skorLatihan = 0.0; $skorMaks = 0.0;

            foreach ($blok as $satuBlok) {
                $baris = $barisMurid->firstWhere('block_id', $satuBlok->getKey());
                $status = $baris?->status->value ?? 'belum';
                if ($satuBlok->wajib) { $jumlahWajib++; if ($status === 'selesai') $selesaiWajib++; }

                $attempt = $baris?->attempt;
                if ($satuBlok->tipe->berkuis() && $attempt?->status === StatusAttempt::Selesai) {
                    $skorLatihan += (float)$attempt->skor;
                    $skorMaks += (float)$attempt->skor_maksimal;
                    $jawaban = $attempt->jawaban->keyBy('question_id');
                    foreach ($satuBlok->kuis?->soal ?? [] as $soal) {
                        $tag = $soal->tag; if ($tag === null) continue;
                        $kunci = (int)$tag->getKey();
                        $temaKumpul[$kunci] ??= ['tag_id'=>$kunci,'tag_nama'=>$tag->nama,'jumlah_soal'=>0,'jumlah_benar'=>0];
                        $temaKumpul[$kunci]['jumlah_soal']++;
                        if ($jawaban->get($soal->getKey())?->benar === true) $temaKumpul[$kunci]['jumlah_benar']++;
                    }
                }

                $perBlok[] = [
                    'block_id' => $satuBlok->getKey(),
                    'urutan' => $satuBlok->urutan,
                    'tipe' => $satuBlok->tipe->value,
                    'tipe_label' => $satuBlok->tipe->label(),
                    'wajib' => $satuBlok->wajib,
                    'status' => $status,
                    'status_label' => $baris?->status->label() ?? 'Belum dibuka',
                    'skor' => (float)($baris->skor ?? 0),
                    'attempt_id' => $baris?->attempt_id,
                    'dikumpulkan_at' => $attempt?->dikumpulkan_at?->toIso8601String(),
                ];
            }

            $tema = [];
            foreach ($temaKumpul as $satuTema) {
                $persen = $satuTema['jumlah_soal'] > 0 ? round($satuTema['jumlah_benar']/$satuTema['jumlah_soal']*100, 1) : 0.0;
                $tingkat = $this->tag->tingkat((int)$satuTema['jumlah_soal'], $persen, $ambang);
                $tema[] = [... 'persen'=>$persen,'tingkat'=>$tingkat,'tingkat_label'=>LaporanTagService::labelTingkat($tingkat)];
            }
            usort($tema, fn($a,$b)=>$a['persen'] <=> $b['persen']);

            $daftar[] = [
              'murid_id'=>, 'nama'=>$satuMurid->user?->name,
              'blok_selesai'=>collect($perBlok)->where('status','selesai')->count(),
              'jumlah_blok'=>count($blok),
              'selesai_wajib'=>$selesaiWajib,'jumlah_wajib'=>$jumlahWajib,
              'skor_latihan'=>round($skorLatihan,2),'skor_latihan_maksimal'=>round($skorMaks,2),
              'tema'=>$tema,'blok'=>$perBlok,
            ];
        }

        return [
          'materi'=>[...],
          'ambang'=>$ambang,
          'blok'=>[... map],
          'murid'=>$daftar,
        ];
    }
}
```

MateriPolicy:
```php
class MateriPolicy
{
    public function viewAny(User $user): bool { return true; }
    public function view(User $user, Materi $materi): bool
    {
        if ($user->isGuru()) return true;
        if (! $materi->terbit()) return false;
        $kelas = $user->murid?->class_id;
        return $kelas !== null && (int)$kelas === (int)$materi->class_id;
    }
    public function create/update/delete/publikasi/laporan → isGuru()
    public function kelolaBerkas(User $user, Materi $materi): bool  => isGuru()
}
```

Requests:
- SimpanMateriRequest: judul, deskripsi, subject_id exists, class_id exists, tag_id nullable exists, urutan nullable int.
- SinkronBlokRequest: `blok` array (nullable), blok.*.tipe in:teks,media,kuis, blok.*.wajib boolean, blok.*.isi array, blok.*.quiz_id nullable integer.
- MulaiUnggahanRequest: nama required string max 255, ukuran required integer min1.
- SimpanPotonganRequest: isi_base64 nullable string, hash nullable string size 64. (either isi_base64 or file potongan)

    public function index(Request $request, SekolahService $sekolah): AnonymousResourceCollection

```php
class BerkasController extends Controller
{
    public function __invoke(string $kode, PenyimpananMateri $penyimpanan): Response
    {
        $unggahan = UnggahanMateri::query()->where('kode',$kode)->where('status', Selesai)->firstOrFail();
        $path = $unggahan->path;
        $namaUnduh = $unggahan->nama_asli; // for risky add .upload? ekstensi already 'upload' on disk
        // Cat 2/3: attachment + nama asli + '.upload'
        $headers = [
            'X-Content-Type-Options' => 'nosniff',
            'Content-Type' => $unggahan->mime,
            'Cache-Control' => 'private, max-age=0, must-revalidate',
        ];
        if ($unggahan->kategori->bolehTampilLangsung()) {
            $headers['Content-Disposition'] = 'inline; filename="'.$this->bersih($namaUnduh).'"';
        } else {
            $headers['Content-Disposition'] = 'attachment; filename="'.$this->bersih($namaUnduh).'.upload"';
        }
        $prefix = config('material.x_accel_prefix');
        if (!empty($prefix)) {
            $headers['X-Accel-Redirect'] = $penyimpanan->pathInternal($unggahan);
            return response('', 200, $headers);
        }
        if (! Storage::disk(PenyimpananMateri::DISK)->exists($path)) abort(404);
        return response()->file(Storage::disk(...)->path($path), $headers);
    }
}
```
Note: for signed route `/berkas/{kode}` with middleware signed:relative.

Also `response()->file()` sets Content-Type from file; our headers override? `response()->file($path, $headers)` merges; the BinaryFileResponse may set its own Content-Type via mime detection, but provided headers take precedence? In Symfony, `setContentDisposition` etc. Actually Laravel's `file()` sets headers via `ResponseHeaderBag`; if we pass Content-Type it should be respected. Let me not overthink; tests will assert headers.

Actually careful: `response()->file()` with 'Content-Type' in $headers — Laravel's `file()` calls `new BinaryFileResponse` then `ResponseHeaderBag::set` for each header, then `setContentDisposition`. Should be fine.

```php
public function buka(Request $request, Materi $materi, BlokMateri $blok, ProgresMateriService $service, AttemptService $attemptService): JsonResponse
{
    $this->authorize('kerjakan', $materi);
    $pengguna = $request->user(); if null abort 401
    $hasil = $service->buka($materi, $blok, $pengguna);
    $payload = ['blok' => $hasil['blok'], 'attempt' => null];
    if ($hasil['attempt'] !== null) {
        $resource = new AttemptResource($hasil['attempt']);
        $resource->soal = $attemptService->payloadSoal($hasil['attempt']);
        $resource->jawaban = $attemptService->payloadJawaban($hasil['attempt']);
        $resource->proteksi = $attemptService->saklarAntiCheat($blok->kuis);
        $payload['attempt'] = $resource->resolve($request);  // resolve gives array
    }
    return response()->json($payload);
}
```
`JsonResource::resolve($request)` returns the array. Good.

function m08Soal(object $ctx, string $tipe, array $konten, array $kunci, int $skor = 4, ?int $tagId = null): Soal
{
    auth()->forgetGuards();
    Sanctum::actingAs($ctx->guru);
    $respons = test()->postJson('/api/v1/soal', [
        'subject_id' => $ctx->mapel->id,
        'tag_id' => $tagId,
        'tipe' => $tipe,
        'konten' => $konten,
        'kunci' => $kunci,
        'skor' => $skor,
    ])->assertCreated();
    return Soal::query()->findOrFail((int) $respons->json('id'));
}
```
Need to check SoalController accepts tag_id. Let me check SimpanSoalRequest rules... likely includes tag_id. I'll assume yes but verify by test run.

```php
function m08Kuis(object $ctx, array $soal): Kuis
{
    $kuis = Kuis::factory()->untukSekolah($ctx->sekolah, $ctx->mapel, $ctx->kelas)->berjalan()->create(['acak_soal'=>false,'acak_opsi'=>false]);
    foreach (array_values($soal) as $urutan => $satu) { $kuis->soal()->attach($satu->id, ['urutan'=>$urutan+1]); }
    return $kuis->refresh();
}

function m08Materi(object $ctx, array $data = []): Materi  // via API
{
    auth()->forgetGuards(); Sanctum::actingAs($ctx->guru);
    $id = (int) test()->postJson('/api/v1/materi', array_merge([
        'judul' => 'Materi Penjumlahan', 'subject_id' => $ctx->mapel->id, 'class_id' => $ctx->kelas->id, 'tag_id' => $ctx->tag->id,
    ], $data))->assertCreated()->json('id');
    return Materi::query()->findOrFail($id);
}

function m08Unggah(object $ctx, Materi $materi, string $nama, string $isi): array
{
    auth()->forgetGuards(); Sanctum::actingAs($ctx->guru);
    $mulai = test()->postJson("/api/v1/materi/{$materi->id}/unggahan", ['nama'=>$nama,'ukuran'=>strlen($isi)])->assertCreated();
    $kode = (string) $mulai->json('kode');
    $jumlah = (int) $mulai->json('jumlah_potongan');
    $chunk = (int) config('material.chunk_byte');
    for ($i=0;$i<$jumlah;$i++) {
        $bagian = substr($isi, $i*$chunk, $chunk);
        test()->putJson("/api/v1/unggahan/{$kode}/potongan/{$i}", ['isi_base64'=>base64_encode($bagian),'hash'=>hash('sha256',$bagian)])->assertOk();
    }
    $selesai = test()->postJson("/api/v1/unggahan/{$kode}/selesai")->assertOk();
    return ['kode'=>$kode,'response'=>$selesai];
}
```

Note `putJson` works for the route. Good.

For PNG bytes: minimal PNG signature `\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n` + some bytes.

```php
it('mengunggah materi berkategori umum dan menyajikannya lewat URL bertanda tangan', function (): void {
    $materi = m08Materi($this);
    $isi = "\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n".str_repeat('a', 100);
    $hasil = m08Unggah($this, $materi, 'peta.png', $isi);

    expect($hasil['response']->json('kategori'))->toBe('umum')
        ->and($hasil['response']->json('ekstensi'))->toBe('png')
        ->and($hasil['response']->json('mime'))->toBe('image/png')
        ->and($hasil['response']->json('hash'))->toBe(hash('sha256',$isi));

    $unggahan = UnggahanMateri::query()->where('kode',$hasil['kode'])->firstOrFail();
    expect(Storage::disk('local')->exists((string) $unggahan->path))->toBeTrue()
        ->and(Storage::disk('public')->exists((string) $unggahan->path))->toBeFalse();

    // Murid bisa memuat tanpa sesi, cukup URL bertanda tangan.
    auth()->forgetGuards();
    $url = (string) $hasil['response']->json('url');
    $respons = $this->get($url)->assertOk();
    expect($respons->headers->get('X-Content-Type-Options'))->toBe('nosniff')
        ->and($respons->headers->get('Content-Type'))->toBe('image/png')
        ->and($respons->headers->get('Content-Disposition'))->toContain('inline');
});
```

```php
public function getRelationValue($key)
{
    if ($this->relationLoaded($key)) return $this->relations[$key];
    if (! $this->isRelation($key)) return;
    if ($this->preventsLazyLoading) {
        $this->handleLazyLoadingViolation($key);
    }
    return $this->getRelationshipFromMethod($key);
}
```
and `handleLazyLoadingViolation` throws unless a custom callback set. Laravel sets a default callback in `Model::preventLazyLoading()`:
```php
public static function preventLazyLoading($value = true) {
    static::$modelsShouldPreventLazyLoading = $value;
    if (! $value) { static::handleLazyLoadingViolationUsing(null); }
}
```
And `handleLazyLoadingViolation` → if `static::$lazyLoadingViolationCallback` set, call it; else `throw new LazyLoadingViolationException($this, $relation);` — BUT guarded by `if (! $this->exists) return;`.

`handleLazyLoadingViolation`:
```php
public function handleLazyLoadingViolation($key)
{
    if (isset(static::$lazyLoadingViolationCallback)) {
        return call_user_func(static::$lazyLoadingViolationCallback, $this, $key);
    }
    if (! $this->exists || $this->wasRecentlyCreated) {
        return;
    }
    throw new LazyLoadingViolationException($this, $key);
}
```

`unggahBerkas(materiId, berkas, opsi)`:
```js
export async function unggahBerkas(materiId, berkas, { onProgres } = {}) {
  await ambilCsrfCookie()
  const sesi = await mulaiUnggahan(materiId, { nama: berkas.name, ukuran: berkas.size })
  const gumpalan = potongBerkas(await berkas.arrayBuffer(), sesi.ukuran_potongan)
  for (let i = 0; i < gumpalan.length; i++) {
    await kirimPotongan(sesi.kode, i, gumpalan[i])
    onProgres?.(Math.round(((i + 1) / gumpalan.length) * 100))
  }
  return selesaikanUnggahan(sesi.kode)
}
```
Careful: `sesi.jumlah_potongan` may be less than gumpalan.length if chunking differs; use gumpalan.length.

potongBerkas(isi, ukuranPotongan):
```js
export function potongBerkas(isi, ukuranPotongan) {
  const ukuran = Number(ukuranPotongan) > 0 ? Number(ukuranPotongan) : 1024 * 1024
  const buffer = isi instanceof ArrayBuffer ? isi : new Uint8Array(isi).buffer
  const potongan = []
  for (let mulai = 0; mulai < buffer.byteLength; mulai += ukuran) {
    potongan.push(buffer.slice(mulai, Math.min(mulai + ukuran, buffer.byteLength)))
  }
  return potongan.length > 0 ? potongan : [new ArrayBuffer(0)]
}
```
Hmm, for empty file we send 1 empty chunk; backend rejects ukuran<=0 anyway.

kirimPotongan(kode, indeks, buffer):
```js
export async function kirimPotongan(kode, indeks, buffer) {
  await ambilCsrfCookie()
  const bentuk = new FormData()
  bentuk.append('potongan', new Blob([buffer], { type: 'application/octet-stream' }), `potongan-${indeks}.bin`)
  const respons = await client.put(`/v1/unggahan/${kode}/potongan/${indeks}`, bentuk)
  return skemaResponsPotongan.parse(respons.data)
}
```

Pure UI helper `blokBerikutnya(ringkasan)`:
```js
export function blokBerikutnya(ringkasan) {
  const blok = [...(ringkasan?.blok ?? [])].sort((a, b) => a.urutan - b.urutan)
  for (const b of blok) {
    if (b.wajib && b.status !== 'selesai') return b
  }
  return blok.find((b) => b.status !== 'selesai') ?? null
}
```
And `bolehDibuka(ringkasan, blok)`:
```js
export function bolehDibuka(ringkasan, blok) {
  const sebelumnya = (ringkasan?.blok ?? []).filter((b) => b.urutan < blok.urutan && b.wajib)
  return sebelumnya.every((b) => b.status === 'selesai')
}
```

export default function HalamanMateri() {
  const [terpilihId, setTerpilihId] = useState(null)
  const [blok, setBlok] = useState([])
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ judul: '', deskripsi: '', subject_id: '', class_id: '', tag_id: '' })
  const [galat, setGalat] = useState('')
  const [progresUnggah, setProgresUnggah] = useState(0)
  const queryClient = useQueryClient()

  const daftar = useQuery({ queryKey: ['materi'], queryFn: ambilMateri })
  const kelas = useQuery({ queryKey: ['kelas'], queryFn: ambilKelas })
  const mapel = useQuery({ queryKey: ['mapel'], queryFn: ambilMapel })
  const tag = useQuery({ queryKey: ['tag'], queryFn: ambilTag })
  const kuis = useQuery({ queryKey: ['kuis'], queryFn: ambilKuis })
  const detail = useQuery({ queryKey:['materi', terpilihId], queryFn: () => ambilMateriDetail(terpilihId), enabled: terpilihId !== null })
  const laporan = useQuery({...enabled terpilih && status publikasi})

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!detail.data) return
    setBlok((detail.data.blok ?? []).map((b) => ({ tipe: b.tipe, wajib: b.wajib, teks: b.teks ?? '', unggahan_kode: b.unggahan_kode ?? '', quiz_id: b.quiz_id ?? '' , kuis_judul: b.kuis_judul ?? '', keterangan: b.keterangan ?? ''})))
  }, [detail.data])

  const simpanMateri = useMutation({...})
  const simpanBlok = useMutation({...})
  const publikasi = useMutation({...})
  ...
}
```

## Format Dokumentasi (revisi)

Schema::create('avatars', function (Blueprint $table) {
    $table->id();
    $table->foreignId('school_id')->constrained('schools')->cascadeOnDelete();
    $table->foreignId('student_id')->constrained('students')->cascadeOnDelete();
    $table->string('kode', 32)->unique();
    $table->string('path');
    $table->string('mime', 100)->default('image/jpeg');
    $table->unsignedInteger('ukuran');
    $table->unsignedSmallInteger('lebar');
    $table->unsignedSmallInteger('tinggi');
    $table->string('hash', 64);
    $table->string('status', 20)->default('aktif');
    $table->unsignedInteger('jumlah_laporan')->default(0);  // laporan unik yang dihitung
    $table->timestamp('disembunyikan_at')->nullable();
    $table->timestamps();
    $table->index(['student_id', 'created_at']);
    $table->index(['school_id', 'status']);
});

Schema::create('avatar_reports', function (Blueprint $table) {
    $table->id();
    $table->foreignId('avatar_id')->constrained('avatars')->cascadeOnDelete();
    $table->foreignId('reporter_id')->constrained('students')->cascadeOnDelete();
    $table->foreignId('school_id')->constrained('schools')->cascadeOnDelete();

```php
namespace App\Sections\Avatar\Policies;

class AvatarPolicy
{
    public function viewAny(User $user): bool { return true; }

    /** Lihat satu avatar: guru selalu; pemilik selalu; murid lain hanya bila aktif & sekelas. */
    public function lihat(User $user, Avatar $avatar): bool
    {
        if ($user->isGuru()) return true;
        $profil = $user->murid;
        if ($profil === null) return false;
        if ((int) $profil->getKey() === (int) $avatar->student_id) return true;
        return $avatar->terlihatSemua() && (int) $profil->class_id === (int) ($avatar->murid?->class_id);
    }

    /** Murid mengunggah/menghapus avatarnya sendiri (punya profil murid). */
    public function unggah(User $user): bool { return $user->isMurid() && $user->murid !== null; }

    public function hapusSendiri(User $user): bool { return $user->isMurid() && $user->murid !== null; }

    /** Melaporkan avatar teman. */
    public function lapor(User $user, Avatar $avatar): bool
    {
        if (! $user->isMurid()) return false;
        $profil = $user->murid;
        if ($profil === null) return false;
        if ((int) $profil->getKey() === (int) $avatar->student_id) return false;
        return $avatar->terlihatSemua() && $this->lihat($user, $avatar);
    }

    /** Antrean moderasi + pulihkan/hapus: guru saja. */
    public function moderasi(User $user): bool { return $user->isGuru(); }

    public function delete(User $user, Avatar $avatar): bool { return $user->isGuru(); }
}
```

public function daftar(Request $request): JsonResponse
{
    $this->authorize('viewAny', Avatar::class);
    $pengguna = $request->user();
    if ($pengguna === null) abort(401);

    if ($pengguna->isGuru()) {
        $avatar = Avatar::query()->where('status','!=',Dihapus)->with([...])->orderByDesc('id')->get();
    } else {
        $profil = $pengguna->murid;
        if ($profil === null) abort(403);
        $ids = Murid::query()->where('class_id', $profil->class_id)->pluck('id');
        $avatar = Avatar::query()->whereIn('student_id', $ids)
            ->where(function ($q) use ($profil) {
                $q->where('status', Aktif)->orWhere('student_id', $profil->getKey());
            })

public function unggah(UnggahAvatarRequest $request, PenyimpananAvatar $penyimpanan): JsonResponse
{
    $this->authorize('unggah', Avatar::class);
    $pengguna = $request->user(); if null abort 401;
    $profil = $pengguna->murid; if null abort 403;
    $isi = $request->isi();
    if ($isi === '') throw ValidationException::withMessages(['berkas' => 'Pilih gambar dulu.']);
    $avatar = $penyimpanan->simpan($profil, $isi);
    return (new AvatarResource($avatar->load(['murid.user','murid.kelas'])))->response()->setStatusCode(201);
}

BerkasAvatarController:
```php
class BerkasAvatarController extends Controller
{
    public function __invoke(string $kode, PenyimpananAvatar $penyimpanan): Response
    {
        $avatar = Avatar::query()->where('kode', $kode)->where('status','!=',Dihapus)->firstOrFail();
        $headers = [
            'X-Content-Type-Options' => 'nosniff',
            'Content-Type' => (string) $avatar->mime,
            'Cache-Control' => 'private, max-age=0, must-revalidate',
            'Content-Disposition' => 'inline; filename="avatar-'.$avatar->kode.'.jpg"',
            // Gambar tidak pernah dieksekusi; CSP ketat sebagai lapis tambahan.
            'Content-Security-Policy' => "default-src 'none'; sandbox",
        ];
        $prefix = (string) config('avatar.x_accel_prefix','');
        if ($prefix !== '') { $headers['X-Accel-Redirect'] = $penyimpanan->pathInternal($avatar); return response('',200,$headers); }
        $path = (string) $avatar->path;
        if ($path === '' || ! $penyimpanan->disk()->exists($path)) abort(404, 'Gambar tidak ditemukan.');
        return response()->file($penyimpanan->disk()->path($path), $headers);
    }
}
```

```php
function a08Png(int $lebar = 400, int $tinggi = 300): string {
    $g = imagecreatetruecolor($lebar, $tinggi);
    $warna = imagecolorallocate($g, 10, 120, 200);
    imagefilledrectangle($g, 0, 0, $lebar, $tinggi, $warna);
    ob_start(); imagepng($g); $isi = (string) ob_get_clean(); imagedestroy($g); return $isi;
}
```

})

const unggah = useMutation({
  mutationFn: async (berkas) => {
    const pesan = periksaBerkasAvatar(berkas)
    if (pesan) throw new Error(pesan)
    const isi = new Uint8Array(await berkas.arrayBuffer())
    if (jenisGambarDariMagicBytes(isi) === null) {
      throw new Error('Hanya gambar JPEG, PNG, atau WebP. Berkas ini ditolak.')
    }
    return unggahAvatar(berkas)
  },
  onSuccess: () => { setGalat(''); invalidate }
  onError: (e) => setGalat(pesanGalatApi(e)),
})

For PNG encode:
```php
private function encodePng(string $isi): string
{
    try {
        $gambar = @imagecreatefromstring($isi);
    } catch (Throwable) { $gambar = false; }

    if (! $gambar instanceof \GdImage) {
        throw ValidationException::withMessages(['unggahan' => 'Gambar jawaban tidak bisa dibaca.']);
    }

    ob_start();
    imagepng($gambar);
    $keluaran = (string) ob_get_clean();
    imagedestroy($gambar);

    if ($keluaran === '') throw ValidationException::withMessages([...]);

    return $keluaran;
}
```
Note: imagepng on a palette/truecolor image; for canvas-sourced PNG with alpha it's fine.

Should I also cap dimensions to prevent decompression bombs? Good practice: check imagesx/imagesy <= e.g. 6000 and pixel count <= 40M before re-encoding. GD's imagecreatefromstring already may allocate. Let me add a guard using getimagesizefromstring() before decoding:
```php
$info = @getimagesizefromstring($isi);
if ($info === false) → 422
[$lebar,$tinggi] = $info;
if ($lebar*$tinggi > 40_000_000) → 422 'Gambar terlalu besar dimensinya.'
```
Good — that's a real security measure worth adding.

class UnggahanJawabanController extends Controller

    /** Daftar lampiran satu attempt (murid: miliknya; guru: untuk menilai). */
    public function daftar(Attempt $attempt, PenyimpananJawaban $penyimpanan): AnonymousResourceCollection
    {
        $this->authorize('view', $attempt);
        return UnggahanJawabanResource::collection($penyimpanan->daftar($attempt));
    }

    public function mulai(MulaiUnggahanJawabanRequest $request, Attempt $attempt, PenyimpananJawaban $penyimpanan, PengaturanService $pengaturan): JsonResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('unggahJawaban', $attempt);

        $pengguna = $request->user();
        if ($pengguna === null) abort(401, 'Sesi tidak ditemukan.');

        /** @var Soal $soal */
        $soal = Soal::query()->findOrFail((int) $request->validated('question_id'));

        $unggahan = $penyimpanan->mulai(
            $attempt,
            $soal,
            JenisUnggahanJawaban::from((string) $request->validated('jenis')),
            $request->validated('nama'),
            (int) $request->validated('ukuran'),
            $request->validated('durasi_detik') === null ? null : (int) $request->validated('durasi_detik'),
            $this->izinRekam($attempt, $pengaturan),
        );

        return (new UnggahanJawabanResource($unggahan))->response()->setStatusCode(201);
    }

Recording flow:
```jsx
const [izin, setIzin] = useState(false)
const [merekam, setMerekam] = useState(false)
const perekamRef = useRef(null)
const potonganRef = useRef([])
const [detikRekam, setDetikRekam] = useState(0)

async function mulaiRekam() {
  setGalat('')
  if (!izin) { setGalat('Centang dulu izin merekam.'); return }
  try {
    const aliran = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ video: true, audio: true })
    const tipe = MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported('video/webm') ? 'video/webm' : ''
    const perekam = new MediaRecorder(aliran, tipe ? { mimeType: tipe } : undefined)
    potonganRef.current = []
    perekam.ondataavailable = (e) => { if (e.data.size > 0) potonganRef.current.push(e.data) }
    perekam.onstop = async () => {
      aliran.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop())
      const blob = new Blob(potonganRef.current, { type: 'video/webm' })
      ...upload as jenis 'rekam' with durasi_detik
    }
    perekam.start()
    perekamRef.current = perekam
    setMerekam(true)
  } catch { setGalat('Tidak bisa mengakses kamera/mikrofon.') }
}
```
Also a timer for duration + auto-stop at DURASI_REKAM_MAKS.

`createImageBitmap` is widely supported; fallback to raw file on failure.

```jsx
async function kePngKecil(berkas) {
  try {
    const bitmap = await createImageBitmap(berkas)
    const skala = Math.min(1, sisiMaks / Math.max(bitmap.width, bitmap.height))
    const lebar = Math.max(1, Math.round(bitmap.width * skala))
    const tinggi = Math.max(1, Math.round(bitmap.height * skala))
    const kanvas = document.createElement('canvas')
    kanvas.width = lebar; kanvas.height = tinggi
    const konteks = kanvas.getContext('2d')
    if (!konteks) return berkas
    konteks.drawImage(bitmap, 0, 0, lebar, tinggi)
    const blob = await new Promise((r) => kanvas.toBlob((b) => r(b), 'image/png'))
    return blob ?? berkas
  } catch { return berkas }
}
```

My second effect calls `setSedangRekam(false)` inside an effect → that rule may flag it! The summary said: "efek setState dihapus karena ESLint react-hooks/set-state-in-effect".

So I must avoid setState in effects. Restructure: do the auto-stop inside the interval callback instead, and use a functional update to avoid stale state:

```jsx
useEffect(() => {
  if (!sedangRekam) return undefined

  let detik = 0
  const jam = window.setInterval(() => {
    detik += 1
    setDetikRekam(detik)

    if (detik >= DURASI_REKAM_MAKS) {
      window.clearInterval(jam)
      perekam.current?.stop()
      perekam.current = null
      setSedangRekam(false)
    }
  }, 1000)

  return () => window.clearInterval(jam)
}, [sedangRekam])
```
setState inside setInterval callback is fine (not in effect body).
